title: VIDEO EDITOR FULL TIME
description:
Please watch: 
/share/b9b083dac4354b1a9575b8a59a6ac50d



Multi 9-Figures Supplement Brand Hiring | Video Editor | Performance Creative

We're one of the fastest-growing 9-figure all-natural supplement brands in the market. Brands you know swipe our ads every single day. Meta is our primary channel, and we need a video editor to turn our briefs into the ads that help us double spend over the next 12 months.

Start: ASAP.

This is a performance editing seat.

Why this seat is different

Most editing jobs treat you as a pair of hands. You get a brief, you get paired with a mid strategist, you produce their videos, and you rarely ever find out what happened. No data, no credit, no upside and no future career advancement.

This seat works the opposite way. You see exactly how every edit performs. You own each video start to finish. When your edits win, your pay goes up with them.



Not just that - we also work very closely with you to make sure you hit your career goals. If you want to be a creative strategist 6 months down the line, we will train you to get there.



If you want to have your own video editing pod, we can help you get there.



If you want to own the entire video department, we can help you get there.



If you want to double or triple your current income, we can help you get there.





The role

Our creative strategists write the briefs. You turn them into finished ads. Every winner starts as a script and ends in your timeline.

Take creative briefs with reference videos and turn them into finished ads

Build across formats: AI movie ads, Pixar-style ads, claymation, singing ads, skeleton ads, and whatever starts working next. We'll train you on any format you haven't done before. (You don’t need to know all of these but it is a big plus)

Take full ownership of every video you make. Its performance has your name on it, and your bonus is tied to it.

Who you are

Detail-obsessed. Hook timing, caption clarity, pacing, and sound design all matter to you. The gap between a winner and an almost-winner is usually detail.

Fast. You ship high volume without sloppy work. You'd rather deliver a v1 today than a "perfect" cut next week.

Self-starter. You take a brief and run with it. We won't micromanage you. You like owning concepts.

Fluent in AI tools. You already use them in your workflow and you pick up new ones quickly.

Obsessed with ads that sell. E-commerce or DTC ad experience is a plus. If you don't have it, you need to be actively studying the ads that do.

What you get

Fully remote, flexible hours

Competitive base + performance bonus

Upgraded bonus months (some months where you can be paid 2x more bonus)

Full visibility into the data, so you see exactly how your edits perform

Direct access to top-performing strategists, if you want to grow your career

Clear progression into lead video editor or creative strategist

Clear paybumps if performance is good

Best-in-the-game training on ads and video editing

How to apply

Fill out the form: 
/
/f/2kzkx9dc-59898/H1Z7MU09HAX7QFWRLU

The code word is "Meta", so we know you read the whole post.

Hiring process

Application form

Founder and head of video review your form

Paid test task

Final interview

You get your offer letter

What we value

Output, accountability, and a thirst for knowledge. If these don't fit, we won't either.

If you want predictable 9-to-5 work, we're not a fit. If you want your edits to drive a 9-figure brand, apply.

title: Image Data Annotation
description:
We're building an image editing product and need detail-oriented reviewers to check the quality of image cutouts and edits. You'll use a simple web tool (we provide it, nothing to install) to look at images and mark the quality of the result. It's visual work that rewards a sharp eye and consistency.



What you'll do

- You will review transparent "cutout" images and mark them as good, bad, or needs-fixing (e.g. rough edges, leftover background, holes in the subject, cut-off parts).

- Review before/after pairs and judge whether the operation is correct, partial, or wrong.

- Repair the operation using a erase and restore brush.

- Add short tags/notes where prompted. Keep a steady, accurate pace across long sessions.



Requirements

- A good eye for visual detail (edges, fine hair/fur, fringing, transparency).

- Reliable computer + stable internet; comfortable working in a web browser.

- Basic written English (to read short instructions and leave brief notes).

- Consistency and honesty. Quality is checked automatically against known-answer items mixed into the queue.



Nice to have

- Prior data-annotation, QA, or photo-editing experience.

• Knowledge of the process and ability to assist with compliance audits and assessments is a plus.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of experience in network and/or system administration with TSP/MSP/MSSP experience.

• Experience with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
(Read entire application before applying, there is information in here that will make or break your application)



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position

Salary: $1,000–$2,000 CAD/month



Content Crew is looking for talented Video Editors to join our remote creative team.



We work with entrepreneurs, business owners, coaches, and personal brands to turn raw footage into engaging content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
, and LinkedIn.



We're looking for editors who understand that great editing isn't about adding as many effects as possible.



It's about holding attention, telling a story, and making content people actually want to watch.



Compensation & Growth



Starting salary is $1,000 CAD/month, with opportunities to increase your compensation as you grow with the team.



Our Senior Editors currently earn up to $2,000 CAD/month.



We're looking for people who want to stay with Content Crew long-term, continuously improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and grow their compensation along the way.



If you're a great editor, reliable, and consistently produce high-quality work, there is a clear opportunity to progress within our team.



What You'll Be Editing



You'll work on content including:



* Short-form Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

* Talking-head educational content

* Podcasts and long-form YouTube videos

* Meta/Facebook ads

* Client testimonials and case studies

* Promotional videos

* Personal brand content



What We're Looking For



We're looking for editors with a strong creative eye who understand modern social media content.



You should understand:



* Strong hooks and attention-grabbing openings

* Fast, intentional pacing

* Cutting unnecessary pauses and filler

* B-roll selection and placement

* Music and sound design

* Captions and text animation

* Zooms, punch-ins, and pattern interrupts

* Basic colour correction and audio cleanup

* Editing for viewer retention

* How editing styles should change between organic content, ads, podcasts, and YouTube



CapCut is our preferred editing software, but we're open to editors using other programs if you can produce great work.



We're much more interested in the quality of your edits than what software you use.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You...



* Have a strong sense of pacing and storytelling

* Understand current social media editing styles

* Can take raw footage and make creative decisions independently

* Pay attention to small details

* Communicate well

* Hit deadlines consistently

* Take feedback well

* Can turn around edits quickly

* Want a long-term position with a growing creative team



How Our Hiring Process Works



We want to keep our hiring process simple and fast.



Step 1 — Portfolio + Loom Introduction



To apply, send us your portfolio AND a short Loom video introducing yourself.



We're not looking for a polished or scripted introduction. We just want to get to know the person behind the portfolio.



In your Loom, please answer these four questions:



1. What's your name, age, and location?



2. Tell us a little about yourself.

What do you like doing outside of work? Hobbies, interests, sports, games, travel — whatever you're into.



3. How did you get into video editing?



4. What do you like AND dislike about video editing?



Keep it casual. Just be yourself.



Alongside your Loom, send us a link to your portfolio with examples of your best editing work, especially short-form and social media content.



Step 2 — 24-Hour Editing Test



If we love your portfolio and think you could be a great fit for Content Crew, we'll reach out to arrange a test edit.



We'll send you raw footage and assets, and you'll have 24 hours to turn them into a finished video.



We will only ask you to complete a test edit if we are seriously considering hiring you.



We don't want to waste your time.



If you're receiving a test from us, it means we liked your work, we liked your application, and we believe there's a real possibility of you joining our team.



The test is simply our opportunity to see how you approach our footage, how you make creative decisions, and whether your editing style fits our clients.



Step 3 — Hiring Decision



We move fast.



If we love your test video and think you're a good fit, we'll make our hiring decision the following day.



No weeks of interviews.



No five-round hiring process.



Portfolio + Loom → 24-Hour Test → Hiring Decision



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio

Include your strongest examples of short-form and social media editing.



2. Your Loom introduction

Answer the four questions listed above.



3. Your availability

Let us know whether you're available full-time and when you could start.



4. Your primary editing software

CapCut is preferred, but not required.



Applications without both a portfolio and Loom introduction will not be considered.



We're looking for editors who want to become **long-term members of Content Crew, improve their skills, work on great content, and grow with our team.



If you're confident in your editing and think you'd be a great addition to the crew, send us your portfolio and introduce yourself. We'd love to meet you.

title: Supply Chain Lead for Dropshipping Multi-Ecom Stores
description:
Supply Chain Manager — Shopify Dropshipping | High-SKU Operations | $1,200–$1,500/month



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING: ONLY APPLY IF YOU MEET ALL THE REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already managed and proactively improved supply chain operations in a high-volume, high-SKU dropshipping business.



If your experience is limited to order processing, tracking shipments, following up with suppliers, customer service, general logistics, or warehouse inventory management, this position is not the right fit.



We are not looking for someone to learn dropshipping supply chain management on the job.



ABOUT US



We are a global e-commerce company operating a growing portfolio of 30+ Shopify stores, primarily in fashion, jewellery, and homeware.



We work with China-based suppliers and fulfillment agents, shipping to customers across Europe and other international markets.



We're hiring an experienced Supply Chain Manager who can lead our supply chain team, remain hands-on with daily operations, and proactively develop and optimize our supply chain processes.



 ABOUT THE ROLE



- Remote, full-time, long-term position

- Monthly compensation: USD $1,200–$1,500

- Manage 2 direct reports

- Approximately 50% hands-on operations and 50% team management and process improvement

- Report directly to the Operations Manager

- Work closely with the Customer Service Manager



You will be accountable for the performance of the supply chain department, not just the completion of daily tasks.



KPIs YOU WILL OWN



- Order processing time: Under 3 days

- Delivery time: Under 10 days

- Out-of-stock (OOS) save rate: Above 80%

- Fulfillment rate:Above 98%

- Product and inventory health: No more than 3% of inventory requiring follow-up



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Hands-On Supply Chain Operations



- Manage a share of daily order processing, fulfillment exceptions, supplier coordination, and OOS cases.

- Resolve delayed orders, stalled shipments, address issues, lost parcels, returns to sender, and product quality concerns.

- Work directly with China-based suppliers and fulfillment agents to resolve sourcing and dispatch issues.

- Monitor product availability and ensure every unresolved issue has a clear owner and deadline.

- Coordinate with Customer Service to ensure order issues are resolved efficiently.



2. Team Management and Leadership



- Directly manage and develop 2 supply chain team members.

- Allocate daily workloads based on priorities, capacity, and operational urgency.

- Set expectations, deadlines, individual KPIs, and accountability.

- Monitor team performance, provide coaching, and address underperformance.

- Collaborate with Customer Service and other departments to achieve shared operational targets.

- Identify capacity constraints and escalate risks with clear recommendations.



3. Proactive Supply Chain Optimization



**This is one of the most important parts of the role.**



We need someone who has previously identified supply chain weaknesses and personally implemented improvements that delivered measurable results.



You will:



- Investigate recurring fulfillment delays, OOS issues, supplier failures, and delivery exceptions.

- Identify root causes rather than repeatedly reacting to the same problems.

- Develop preventive processes to reduce operational issues before they affect customers.

- Improve supplier performance, product availability monitoring, and order fulfillment workflows.

- Design and implement scalable processes for high-SKU, multi-store operations.

- Identify automation opportunities and work on implementing practical solutions.

- Measure the impact of improvements through clear before-and-after KPIs.



4. Reporting and Performance Management



- Monitor and report daily KPI performance, exceptions, urgent risks, and corrective actions.

- Conduct weekly reviews of operational performance, root causes, and improvement initiatives.

- Develop a prioritized improvement plan with clear owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

- Work with the Operations Manager to continuously improve supply chain performance.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS — ALL MUST BE MET



**Please do not apply unless you meet every requirement below.**



1. Direct high-volume, high-SKU dropshipping experience. 

You must have personally worked in supply chain operations for a dropshipping company handling substantial order volumes and large product catalogs.



2. Proven supply chain optimization experience.

You must have personally developed, improved, or optimized dropshipping supply chain processes. Simply handling daily operational issues does not qualify.



3. Demonstrable KPI improvements.

You must be able to provide specific examples of improvements you delivered, including the starting KPI, actions taken, and measurable results.



4. Direct people management experience.

You must have managed direct reports, assigned workloads, monitored performance, coached team members, and held them accountable for results. Training colleagues alone does not qualify.



5. Hands-on supplier and fulfillment experience.

You must understand China-based sourcing, fulfillment agents, OOS management, supplier coordination, international shipping, and order exceptions.



6. Proactive problem-solving ability.

You must have experience identifying root causes and implementing preventive solutions, not just following up on problems after they occur.



7. Strong data and reporting skills.

You must be proficient in Google Sheets or Excel and experienced in operational KPI tracking, root-cause analysis, and daily/weekly reporting.



8. Excellent written and spoken English.

You must be able to communicate clearly with management, team members, suppliers, and other departments.



 STRONG ADVANTAGES



- Multi-store Shopify dropshipping experience

- High-SKU fashion or apparel operations

- Experience with CJdropshipping or similar China-based fulfillment agents

- Experience with ParcelPanel, 17TRACK, or similar tracking tools

- Experience building dashboards, automated alerts, or operational workflows

- Experience serving European, UK, US, Canadian, or Australian markets



 YOUR FIRST MONTH



During your first month, you will:



- Work alongside both team members to understand current processes and operational challenges.

- Review live orders, supplier workflows, and existing KPI performance.

- Take ownership of a share of daily operational work.

- Identify the biggest causes of delays, OOS issues, and fulfillment inefficiencies.

- Present an evidence-based improvement plan to the Operations Manager, including actions, owners, timelines, and measurable targets.



HOW TO APPLY — STRICT SCREENING



Start your proposal with the exact words "Supply Chain Lead".



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.



Please include:



1. **CV:** Your updated resume.



2. **Dropshipping experience:** Which dropshipping companies have you worked for? Which suppliers or fulfillment agents did you use?



3. **Operational scale:** What was the approximate number of active SKUs, Shopify stores, and daily orders you were personally responsible for?



4. **Proven optimization:** Describe ONE supply chain problem you proactively identified and solved. Include:

   - The original problem and root cause

   - The KPI before your improvement

   - What you personally implemented

   - The KPI after your improvement



5. **People management:** How many people directly reported to you, for how long, and how did you allocate workloads and manage their performance?



6. **Expected salary:** Your expected monthly compensation in USD.





IMPORTANT: 

Generic proposals, AI-generated responses without specific supporting examples, and applications that do not demonstrate the mandatory experience will not be shortlisted.



We are looking for someone who has already done this work successfully, can demonstrate their results, and is ready to take ownership of a growing dropshipping supply chain operation.



**Only apply if you genuinely meet ALL the mandatory requirements.**

title: Controller - Remote, full-time, must overlap US Eastern hours
description:
Silver Lining is hiring a Financial Controller to own the day-to-day finance, bookkeeping, and compliance function for the company. This is a hands-on execution role — not a strategic CFO seat. You keep the books clean, the filings on time, and the numbers trustworthy, so the founders and leadership can make decisions on financials they can rely on.



You take over the day-to-day finance operations the company has been running in-house, working closely with leadership and our external accountants. You own accuracy, timeliness, and compliance end to end, and you are the single point of accountability for the integrity of our books.



How we work — read this before applying



Silver Lining is building toward a modern, AI-assisted finance function. Our intent is to automate the routine reporting, reconciliation, and data-preparation work — and this role is central to helping set that up and then running it as the human in the loop.



In practice that means you will help stand up the tooling and processes, then review, validate, correct, and sign off on AI-prepared work — owning the accuracy and compliance judgment that no tool can own. You should be genuinely comfortable working alongside AI finance tools: directing them, catching their mistakes, knowing when not to trust them, and being personally accountable for the final output that leadership and regulators see.



This is not a role for someone who wants to do everything by hand, and it is not a role for someone who will rubber-stamp whatever a tool produces. We want a controller who treats automation as leverage and treats their own review as the control that makes it safe. Candidates with experience operating as the human reviewer in an AI-augmented or highly automated finance function are strongly preferred.



What you'll do



Bookkeeping & month-end close



Own day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction categorization, journal entries, accruals, and a disciplined month-end close.



Maintain a clean, auditable chart of accounts and consistent coding.



Accounts payable & receivable



Manage AP and AR end to end; run, reconcile, and chase aging.



Ensure vendors are paid on time and receivables are collected and applied correctly.



Reconciliations



Perform and document bank, credit card, and balance-sheet account reconciliations on a fixed cadence.



Investigate and resolve discrepancies, leaving a clear audit trail.



Payroll



Support payroll processing and reconciliation; ensure payroll is recorded accurately and on schedule.



Compliance & filings



Prepare and file required statutory, tax, and compliance filings on time.



Coordinate with external accountants and auditors; prepare clean workpapers and respond to requests.



Track filing deadlines so nothing slips.



Reporting



Produce clean, reliable monthly financial reporting packs — P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.



Deliver them on a predictable schedule with variance notes that a non-financial reader can follow.



AI / automation & controls



Help design and stand up AI and automation tooling for finance (reconciliation, data prep, reporting).



Act as the control point: review and validate tool output before it is relied upon, and own the final sign-off.



Continuously tighten the process so more of the routine work is automated and your time goes to judgment and review.



Communication



Explain financial adjustments and results clearly to non-financial founders and leadership.



Flag risks, cash concerns, and compliance issues early and plainly.

title: Accountant/Bookkeeper
description:
Accountant / Bookkeeper [100% Remote]



⏰ Hours: Full overlap with EST, 9 am to 5 pm

📍 Location: Remote, worldwide (Philippines)



The role:



You carry several eCommerce client files at once, each with their own books and deadlines. Reconciliations, A/P, A/R, journal entries, month-end close, on every file. Our clients are 7- to 9-figure brands, and we work to a five-day close.

We are hiring for multi-client and full cycle. Multi-client means separate clients, not entities inside one company. Full cycle means you have carried a client from bank feed through to a closed month, not just A/P, A/R, or reconciliations.

Your work is reviewed by an accounting manager or senior accountant before it reaches the client, and you are expected to make that review short.



⭐ Must have:



-3+ years in accounting or bookkeeping, in a firm, BPO, or international multi-client environment

-A professional accounting qualification, or one in progress: ACCA, CPA, CA, CIMA, ACA, Contador Público, or your country's equivalent

-Multiple clients, not multiple entities. You have worked across separate client books with their own deadlines and stakeholders. Several subsidiaries of one company in one system is a different job and does not count here.

-Full cycle bookkeeping: reconciliations, A/P, A/R, journal entries, accruals and prepaids

-You have worked to a month-end close and met it. Fixed deadlines preferred. If yours has been rolling, be ready to talk about how you would adapt.

-QuickBooks Online or Xero experience. We will fund your QuickBooks Online certification during onboarding if you do not have it.

-You can follow written instructions precisely, including format, naming, and deadlines, without being reminded.

-Experience working with clients or employers outside your own country, ideally the US, Canada, the UK, or Australia

-English strong enough to be understood in writing and on a live call



✨ Nice to have:



-Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

-eCommerce or consumer goods clients

-Inventory and COGS experience

-Sales tax and multi-jurisdiction compliance

-ClickUp or similar project management tools



✅ What you will do:



-Full-cycle bookkeeping across a portfolio of client files

-Support month-end close: reconciliations, schedules, supporting workpapers

-Record payroll entries, prepaids, and accruals accurately

-Prepare sales tax filings and remittances

-Check your own work before it goes to review. Catching your own errors is part of the job.

-Raise discrepancies clearly and early, with what you have already checked

-Action review notes fully and on time, including the ones that were not itemised for you



🔍 What the job actually looks like:

-Month-end is the most demanding period of the month and falls within the first ten business days. It eases considerably after that.

-You are expected to book around 39 hours a week to client work, tracked accurately.

-Your first two weeks are onboarding, not client work. How you handle that period tells us a lot.

-When you are stuck, you come with the problem and what you have already tried. You do not wait for a scheduled call to raise it.

-Some of our processes are mature, and others are still being built. Tell us when you hit a gap.



🚫 This role is not for you if:

-You need each piece of work handed to you and itemised

-You wait for a scheduled call to raise something rather than flagging it the same day

-You assume an explanation for something that looks wrong instead of checking it

-You are looking for a calmer or less demanding environment. This is public accounting; it is busy by design, and month-end has real pressure in it.

-Working full EST hours would be a strain on your health or your life

-Your current role is AP only, AR only, or audit rather than full cycle accounting



🎁 Benefits:

-Paid time off, Me Days, statutory holidays in your country, year-end company closure

-Certifications and internal training paid for

-Promotion from within based on performance and impact. Several of our leaders started in more junior roles.

-Fully remote, async first



💙 Process:

-Apply via Typeform. Short questions and a brief audio answer. No cover letter.

-Intro call with the People Team, 30 minutes

-Practical assessment

-Final interview with accounting leadership

-Offer

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Captions & Basic Edits)
description:
We’re a real estate media company in Los Angeles. We shoot and edit content for realtors, brokerages, and real estate brands. Our content clients are growing fast, and we need a dedicated editor to keep up with the volume.



This role starts part-time (~20 hrs/week) with room to go full-time (40 hrs/week) as volume grows.



What you’ll do:



Edit short-form vertical videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

Add clean, accurate, on-brand captions to talking-head videos

Do basic cuts: remove pauses, mistakes, and dead air

Add simple b-roll, music, and text overlays when needed

Follow brand templates and style guides for each client

Hit turnaround deadlines, usually 24–48 hours



This role is about volume and consistency, not cinematic editing. If you can turn around clean, captioned videos fast and reliably, you’re who we want.



Requirements:



1+ year editing short-form video

Strong with CapCut and/or Premiere Pro

Excellent English spelling and grammar, because captions must be accurate

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage

Comfortable with Google Drive and Dropbox

Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific time (PST)

Responsive on Slack or WhatsApp during working hours



Nice to have:



Experience with real estate or personal-brand content

Knowledge of social media trends and hooks



How to apply:



Put “CAPTIONS” in your subject line. Applications without it won’t be reviewed.

Send 2–3 links to short-form videos you’ve edited.

Tell us your editing software and how many short videos you can finish in a day.

title: Senior Tax Accountant (US Tax, Remote)
description:
Excel Tax Group, Inc. is a US tax and accounting firm looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to join our fully remote team. You will report directly to the CEO.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will prepare our most complex US tax returns and review returns prepared by junior staff. You will also build deep expertise in one area (international, fiduciary, nonprofit, or entity tax) and help train our team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Complex return preparation:

- Form 1040 with multi-state and complex items

- Form 1065 partnerships and multi-member LLCs

- Form 1120 and 1120-S, including multi-state apportionment and M-1/M-3

- Form 5471, 5472, 3520, 8865, 8938, and FBAR

- Form 1041 (trusts and estates) and Form 706

- Form 990 and 990-T

- Consolidated and multi-jurisdiction returns

- Tax research and written technical memos



Review and training:

- Review returns prepared by junior accountants and give clear, helpful review notes

- Mentor junior staff at least 2 hours a week

- Help write internal SOPs and training materials

- Escalate complex issues to the CPA Practice Manager



Teamwork and clients:

- Take assignments from Practice Managers and the CEO

- Join weekly capacity planning meetings

- Join client calls on technical matters when needed

- Draft client letters on tax positions and IRS notices



WHAT WE EXPECT

- At least 5 years of experience preparing US tax returns

- Strong US tax technical skills and attention to detail

- Clear, patient communication

- Self-directed and accountable while working remotely

- Willing to work extended hours during tax season (Feb to Apr) and in Sep to Oct

- At least 40 hours of continuing education per year

- Reliable high-speed internet and a secure home workspace



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

- Complex return reviews done within 5 business days

- 98% or higher accuracy on your returns

- 1 or fewer rework cycles per return reviewed

- At least 1 SOP, memo, or training per quarter



SALARY

$1,500 to $3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.



To apply, tell us which return types you have the most experience with and how many years you have prepared US returns.

title: Lead Management & Appointment Setter Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly proactive, intelligent, and reliable team member to manage incoming leads, respond to inquiries, and book qualified calls with our team lead.



This is not a basic copy-paste or virtual assistant job. We need someone who can think critically, understand what leads need, communicate professionally, and guide conversations toward booking a call



You should be able to work independently, recognize problems, and find solutions without needing constant supervision



Responsibilities



* Respond to incoming leads promptly and professionally

* Communicate with leads, understand their needs, and answer their questions

* Follow up with leads and turn conversations into booked calls with Ensar

* Manage and organize lead information and appointment schedules

* Keep track of conversations, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

* Identify problems and resolve them independently whenever possible

* Proactively look for ways to improve the workflow and lead conversion process

* Ensure all daily tasks are completed without needing reminders or follow-ups from management



What We’re Looking For



* Highly proactive: You take initiative and do not wait to be told what to do

* Strong problem-solving skills: You analyze situations and find solutions independently instead of immediately escalating every issue

* Critical thinking: You understand context, make sound decisions, and know how to handle different situations

* Excellent communication skills: You can communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English

* Strong organizational skills: You can manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and appointments without losing track

* Reliable and accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities and make sure tasks are completed on time

* Sales-oriented mindset: You understand how to build trust, handle objections, and move conversations toward a clear next step

* Fast learner: You can quickly understand our processes and apply them independently



Important: We Need an Independent Thinker



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work



You should not need someone checking on you every day to make sure your tasks are completed. You are expected to know your responsibilities, manage your workload, follow up with leads consistently, and solve routine problems yourself



If something goes wrong, we expect you to assess the situation and try to find a solution before asking for help. Of course, important issues should be escalated when necessary, but constantly relying on management for basic decisions is not what we are looking for



We value initiative, accountability, and results over simply being online for a certain number of hours



To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience

2. Your experience with lead management, appointment setting, sales, or customer communication

3. An example of a problem you solved independently at work without waiting for instructions

4. Your expected monthly salary and availability



For faster communication during the application process, reach out on

title: AI SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST
description:
ChatGPT + Claude + Copywriting + Video Editing + ManyChat Automation

In D Sky Media | Founder's Personal Brand (including Design for Greatness)



Remote | PST Hours | Part-Time to Full-Time

Pay: Monthly salary based on your experience and skills. Part-time pay is adjusted to the hours.



Who We Are:

We are a premium real estate media and marketing group in the San Francisco Bay Area. You will create content for two things: In D Sky Media (our marketing and branding agency) and our founder's personal brand, which includes Design for Greatness (life and business coaching). We move fast, build smart systems, and care deeply about the people we work with.



Who We Are Looking For:

We need a social media person who uses ChatGPT and Claude every day to write, edit, and create faster. You can write a strong hook, edit a short video, and post it on time. You also know how to set up automations, so when someone comments on a post, they get a message right away. You do not wait to be told what to do next.

Must Haves (No Exceptions):

-Short video editing (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

-Hands-on automation with ManyChat or Go High Level: you can build comment-to-DM flows (someone comments a keyword, and the system sends them a message right away)

-Strong written English that sounds warm and professional

-Available during PST (California) business hours

-Use of the scrin.io tracker during all working hours



What You Will Do:

-Write captions, hooks, and scripts using ChatGPT and Claude, then edit them so they sound like our brand

-Edit short videos from raw clips (cuts, captions, music, and polish)

-Schedule and post across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn

-Build comment-to-DM automations in ManyChat or GHL. Example: a post says "Comment LET'S GO," and the system DMs the guide, link, or booking page to everyone who comments

-Test every automation before it goes live, and fix it fast if it breaks

-Turn one long video or blog into many short posts

-Reply to comments and messages in our brand voice

-Send a simple weekly report: what we posted, what worked, what to do next

-Work with Mika and the team, and follow our Loom training videos



Nice to Have

-Canva Pro experience

-Go High Level (GHL) social planner experience

-Marketing agency or personal brand content experience

-Experience working for more than one brand



How to Apply

-Send ALL of the following. Incomplete applications will not be read.

-Your updated resume

-Your expected monthly salary in US dollars and how many years of experience you have

-A Loom video (2 to 3 minutes). Start by saying the word "Skybound." Then share your screen and show us how you use ChatGPT or Claude to write one post from start to finish. The strategy creation, copy, visual, past and automation. 

-2 short videos you edited. Send the raw clip and the finished version if you can

-One automation you built in ManyChat or GHL. Send a short screen recording or screenshots that show the keyword comment and the automatic DM reply

-Written answer: "Show us the exact prompt you gave ChatGPT or Claude to write a caption. What did you change before posting, and why?"



What Happens Next:

- Top applicants do a short 3-draft post, 1 short video, and 1 working comment-to-DM automation for one of our brands. Strong work earns the job. We promote from within and reward people who think like owners.

title: Home Health Medical Billing & ICD-10/OASIS Coding Specialist
description:
**Remote Home Health Medical Billing & ICD-10/OASIS Coding Specialist (Part-Time)**



**Company:** Viva Life Home Health & Home Care  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Schedule:** Part-Time, approximately 15 - 20 hours per week  

**Compensation:** $7–$10/hour, depending on experience



**About Us**



Viva Life Home Health & Home Care is a U.S.-based home health agency located in San Antonio, Texas. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented individual virtual assistant to support our medical billing, ICD-10 diagnosis coding, and OASIS documentation review.



We use **CareVoyant** as our EMR system. Previous CareVoyant experience is strongly preferred.



**Key Responsibilities**



**ICD-10 Coding & OASIS Review**

- Review home health clinical documentation and assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes.

- Review OASIS assessments for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with clinical documentation.

- Ensure coding complies with Medicare guidelines and PDGM requirements.

- Review Plans of Care (485), physician orders, and supporting documentation.

- Identify documentation deficiencies and coordinate corrections with our clinical team.



**Medical Billing & Claims**

- Prepare and submit Medicare and commercial insurance home health claims.

- Support Notice of Admission (NOA) and final claim processing.

- Verify billing accuracy before claims submission.

- Monitor rejected, denied, and unpaid claims.

- Perform payment posting, accounts receivable follow-up, and billing reconciliation.

- Maintain accurate billing and coding records within CareVoyant.



**Required Qualifications**

- Minimum 2 years of experience supporting U.S. home health agencies.

- Working knowledge of ICD-10-CM diagnosis coding and OASIS assessments.

- Experience with Medicare home health billing and PDGM.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

- Excellent English communication and attention to detail.

- Reliable internet connection and secure remote work environment.



**Preferred Qualifications**

- Hands-on CareVoyant experience.

- Nursing background or CPC, CCS, HCS-D, or similar coding credentials.

- Experience handling both clinical coding/QA and medical billing independently.

- Familiarity with Medicare billing denials and claims follow-up.



**How to Apply**



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of U.S. home health coding and billing experience do you have?

2. Have you worked with CareVoyant? If yes, describe your responsibilities.

3. Do you personally perform both ICD-10/OASIS coding and Medicare home health billing?

4. Which EMR systems have you used?

5. What is your expected hourly rate?

6. Are you available for 20 hours per week, with some overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours?



**Important:** We are looking for an individual professional, not a staffing agency. Candidates with direct home health agency experience will receive priority consideration.

title: Care manager
description:
About us



We work with older adults and their families navigating complex care situations. People managing chronic conditions, recovering after a hospital stay, or trying to stay independent at home while their needs change. 



The families who come to us are usually in the middle of something difficult. A parent has had a fall. A diagnosis has come through. Siblings disagree about what should happen next. A family member has been discharged with a list of instructions the rest of the family doesn't understands.



Our job is to make sense of that, and then make it happen.



---



About the role



We are looking for an experienced **Care Manager** based in the Philippines to support healthcare coordination workflows for U.S.-based patients.



The strongest candidates will have personally managed patient cases and coordinated across multiple stakeholders such as patients, families, providers, health plans, pharmacies, home health agencies, and/or community resources.



We are especially interested in people who already understand how care-management work is actually delivered behind the scenes: who assigns the work, how patients enter the program, which tasks the care manager owns, what gets escalated, which systems are used, and where the process tends to break down.



---



What You'll Do



Assess situations



Lead intake conversations with clients and families to understand functional needs, cognitive changes, home environment, family dynamics, and what support is realistically available.



Build and adapt  care plans



Turn that assessment into a practical plan: what needs to happen, in what order, how urgently, and who should be involved.



Adjust the plan as the client's and family's needs change over time.



Navigate family dynamics



Support families through difficult decisions, conflicting opinions, and caregiver strain.



Know when to push for action, when to slow things down, and how to keep everyone moving toward a workable plan.



Coordinate care



Help clients get to the right providers and services, follow referrals through, unblock delays, and keep the different pieces of care connected.



Maintain clear documentation and lines of communication to stakeholders where needed, including updating patient records, collaborating with other stakeholders, communicating proactively to the patient and family as needed, using judgement to to prevent small problems from becoming crises. 



---



Ideal Experience



- 2+ years of care management, case management, or patient-navigation experience

- Direct experience supporting U.S. patients or healthcare organizations

- Experience managing a patient or member caseload

- Comfortable coordinating across several healthcare organizations at once

- Experience handling follow-ups involving appointments, referrals, medications, insurance, or care services

- Strong understanding of how patient issues are tracked, escalated, and resolved

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong problem-solving and follow-through

- Comfortable working independently and explaining how you approach a case from start to finish

- Willingness to adapt to new documentation tools and workflows



---



Backgrounds We’re Excited About



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have experience with:



- High-volume caseload management

- Medicare or Medicaid populations

- Health-plan care-management programs

- Care coordination performed on behalf of a payer or provider

- Third-party organizations contracted by U.S. health plans or providers

- Complex or chronic-care populations

- Older adults and their families

- Medication access or adherence

- Referral and appointment coordination

- Prior authorization or insurance-related follow-up

- Community-resource navigation



Tools



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



- EHR / EMR or other patient data systems

- Epic or similar clinical systems

- Salesforce or healthcare CRMs

- Scheduling platforms

- Patient communication tools

- Health-plan portals

- Task-management or case-management systems



Work Setup



- Remote

- Philippines-based

- Must have reliable internet and a computer

- Must be comfortable supporting U.S.-based healthcare workflows

- Schedule and employment arrangement to be discussed



---



How to Apply



Send your CV along with a 1–2 minute video introduction covering:



1. Your most relevant care-management experience



What was your role, what type of organization did you work for, and who were you supporting? For example: older adults, Medicare or Medicaid members, home health patients, chronic-care patients, or another population.



2. How your role was structured



Were you employed directly by a U.S. healthcare company, working through a BPO or staffing company, supporting a health plan or provider, or working under another arrangement?



3. What you personally owned



In a few sentences, tell us the kinds of patient needs you were responsible for managing. We’re especially interested in experience involving coordination across providers, appointments, referrals, medications, insurance, family members, or community services.



4. One example of a complex situation you helped move forward



Briefly describe the situation and what your role was. You don’t need to share any patient-identifying information.



Please also include your availability for a conversation this week.



We’re especially interested in candidates who have done this work firsthand and can speak clearly about how care coordination works in practice.

title: Senior Paid Media Specialist (Meta & Google Ads)
description:
About Us



En Masse is a boutique digital advertising agency based in Sydney, Australia. We work with ambitious brands and businesses to create strategic, results-driven advertising campaigns that deliver measurable growth.



We're a growing agency with big ambitions, and we're looking for an experienced Paid Media Specialist to join us on a flexible freelance basis.



About the Role



We're looking for someone who genuinely knows their way around Meta and Google Ads.



You'll work directly with the agency founder to support campaign strategy, technical implementation, performance optimisation and account audits across a growing portfolio of clients.



This isn't a junior execution role. We're looking for a confident, analytical specialist who can take ownership of technical challenges, identify opportunities and bring valuable expertise to the table.



Key Responsibilities



Audit Meta and Google Ads accounts and identify performance opportunities.



Review and optimise campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.



Support campaign setup, testing, optimisation and scaling.



Troubleshoot performance issues, tracking discrepancies and conversion problems.



Implement and review Meta Pixel, Conversions API, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

title: VIDEO EDITOR FULL TIME
description:
Please watch: 



Multi 9-Figures Supplement Brand Hiring | Video Editor | Performance Creative

We're one of the fastest-growing 9-figure all-natural supplement brands in the market. Brands you know swipe our ads every single day. Meta is our primary channel, and we need a video editor to turn our briefs into the ads that help us double spend over the next 12 months.

Start: ASAP.

This is a performance editing seat.

Why this seat is different

Most editing jobs treat you as a pair of hands. You get a brief, you get paired with a mid strategist, you produce their videos, and you rarely ever find out what happened. No data, no credit, no upside and no future career advancement.

This seat works the opposite way. You see exactly how every edit performs. You own each video start to finish. When your edits win, your pay goes up with them.



Not just that - we also work very closely with you to make sure you hit your career goals. If you want to be a creative strategist 6 months down the line, we will train you to get there.



If you want to have your own video editing pod, we can help you get there. 



If you want to own the entire video department, we can help you get there.



If you want to double or triple your current income, we can help you get there. 





The role

Our creative strategists write the briefs. You turn them into finished ads. Every winner starts as a script and ends in your timeline.

Take creative briefs with reference videos and turn them into finished ads

Build across formats: AI movie ads, Pixar-style ads, claymation, singing ads, skeleton ads, and whatever starts working next. We'll train you on any format you haven't done before. (You don’t need to know all of these but it is a big plus)

Take full ownership of every video you make. Its performance has your name on it, and your bonus is tied to it.

Who you are

Detail-obsessed. Hook timing, caption clarity, pacing, and sound design all matter to you. The gap between a winner and an almost-winner is usually detail.

Fast. You ship high volume without sloppy work. You'd rather deliver a v1 today than a "perfect" cut next week.

Self-starter. You take a brief and run with it. We won't micromanage you. You like owning concepts. 

Fluent in AI tools. You already use them in your workflow and you pick up new ones quickly.

Obsessed with ads that sell. E-commerce or DTC ad experience is a plus. If you don't have it, you need to be actively studying the ads that do.

What you get

Fully remote, flexible hours

Competitive base + performance bonus 

Upgraded bonus months (some months where you can be paid 2x more bonus)

Full visibility into the data, so you see exactly how your edits perform

Direct access to top-performing strategists, if you want to grow your career

Clear progression into lead video editor or creative strategist 

Clear paybumps if performance is good

Best-in-the-game training on ads and video editing

How to apply

Fill out the form: 

The code word is "Meta", so we know you read the whole post.

Hiring process

Application form

Founder and head of video review your form

Paid test task 

Final interview

You get your offer letter

What we value

Output, accountability, and a thirst for knowledge. If these don't fit, we won't either.

If you want predictable 9-to-5 work, we're not a fit. If you want your edits to drive a 9-figure brand, apply.

title: Outbound B2B Appointment Setter – U.S. Market (Merchant Services / POS)
description:
# Inside Sales Representative – U.S. Market (Remote, Philippines)



**Payco Enterprises, Inc. | Full-Time | $5.00 USD/Hour + Uncapped Commissions + Performance Bonuses**



## Do You Live on the Phone? Are You a Natural Salesperson?



Payco is a growing U.S.-based fintech and commerce technology company seeking motivated, experienced sales professionals in the Philippines to join our inside sales team.



We provide businesses throughout the United States with credit card processing, point-of-sale (POS) systems, IT support, e-commerce solutions, and integrated business technology.



We're looking for individuals who are confident on the phone, comfortable speaking with American business owners, and motivated by performance-based compensation.



Your initial focus will be generating qualified sales appointments while developing the knowledge and skills necessary to manage the complete sales process and independently close deals.



**This is a performance-driven sales position. Representatives are required to close a minimum of 8 qualifying merchant accounts per month to maintain employment, subject to applicable employment laws.**



## Schedule and Work Arrangement



- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Schedule:** Monday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM (U.S. Pacific Time)

- **Hours:** 35 paid hours per week, with a 30-minute unpaid lunch Monday through Thursday and a one-hour unpaid lunch Friday

- **Employment:** Full-time remote position

- **Base Pay:** $5.00 USD per hour

- **Approximate Monthly Base:** $758.33 USD, plus commissions and bonuses



Candidates must be available during scheduled U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



## Responsibilities



- Make high-volume outbound calls to U.S. businesses using our VoIP system and power dialer.

- Reach business owners and decision-makers, navigate gatekeepers, and introduce Payco's solutions.

- Identify opportunities to reduce processing costs and improve business operations.

- Schedule qualified appointments with prospective merchants.

- Request processing statements for cost analyses and sales presentations.

- Conduct discovery calls, handle objections, and present customized solutions.

- Close merchant processing, POS, and technology agreements over the phone.

- Follow up consistently with prospective clients.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, prospect information, and sales activity.

- Manage opportunities from initial contact through account activation.



## Performance Expectations



- 200+ outbound dialing attempts per day

- 15+ decision-maker conversations per day

- 10+ qualified appointments scheduled per week

- 80%+ appointment attendance rate

- Accurate and timely CRM updates

- **Minimum 8 qualifying closed merchant accounts per month**



**Maintaining a minimum of 8 qualifying closed deals per month is an ongoing employment requirement, subject to applicable employment laws.**



## Compensation and Commissions



**Base Pay: $5.00 USD per hour**



Commissions are paid on qualifying merchant accounts personally closed, based on monthly processing volume.



| Monthly Merchant Processing Volume | Commission |

|---|---:|

| $10,000 or less | $0 |

| Over $10,000 but under $25,000 | $20 |

| $25,000–$49,999.99 | $50 |

| $50,000–$100,000 | $100 |

| Over $100,000 through $200,000 | $200 |

| Over $200,000 but under $500,000 | $250 |

| $500,000 and above | $350 |



Accounts processing $10,000 or less per month do not qualify for commissions or monthly deal-count bonuses.



Qualifying accounts processing more than $10,000 but less than $25,000 earn a $20 commission and may count toward the monthly quota and bonus thresholds, up to a maximum of 3 such accounts per month.



### Monthly Performance Bonuses



- **8–11 closed deals:** $250 bonus

- **12 or more closed deals:** Additional $500 bonus

- **Maximum cumulative monthly bonus:** $750



Commissions are uncapped and paid monthly according to the written commission agreement.



## Earnings Potential



Based on 35 paid hours per week:



- **Monthly Base Salary:** Approximately $758.33 USD

- **Annual Base Salary:** $9,100 USD

- **Additional Earnings:** Uncapped commissions and monthly performance bonuses



For example, closing 8 qualifying deals with an average commission of $200 per account would generate:



- Base Pay: $758.33

- Commissions: $1,600

- Performance Bonus: $250

- **Total Estimated Monthly Earnings: $2,608.33 USD**

title: Bookkeeper / Accounting Specialist – Vacation Rental Property Management (Xero, TopKey, Trust Accounting)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a growing vacation rental management company in Lake Tahoe, California. We manage more than 100 short-term rental homes for homeowners in California and Nevada, and we plan to keep growing over the next few years. Our books are kept in Xero by an outside CPA firm. We need a hands-on, in-house bookkeeper to own the day-to-day accounting work and act as the point person who keeps trust and operating items moving.



This role is for someone who finishes what they start. You follow up until things are actually resolved, you ask instead of guessing, and you check your own work before anything leaves your desk. Accuracy and follow-through matter more here than almost anywhere else in the company, because homeowners trust us with their money.



SCHEDULE: Full-time, 45 hours per week, Monday–Friday. Night shift in the Philippines covering US Pacific Time business hours (exact hours confirmed at hire). Reliable internet and a quiet workspace required.

SALARY: USD $1,395 per month ($7/hr base for 45 hrs/week, plus a $30/month internet stipend), paid twice monthly on the 15th and 30th

START DATE: ASAP



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Transactions and expenses (daily)

- Review, code, and categorize every company card and bank transaction in TopKey so it is ready to sync to Xero.

- Match receipts to transactions daily, and chase missing receipts and missing details with the cardholder. Don't just leave a comment and wait.

- D
 correctly whether each charge is owner-billable, a company expense, or a pass-through. For example, a permit or repair billed back to a homeowner is not a general company expense.

- Create owner charges in TopKey and push them to our property management system (Streamline). Make sure the posted dates match the statement period.

- Code lodging/occupancy tax (TOT) transactions to the correct accounts every time, following our documented process.



Accounts payable (twice a week)

- Turn invoices from our bills inbox into bills in TopKey and route them for approval under our approval thresholds.

- Before paying anything, check it against the work order, approval, amount, and rate.

- Pay vendors on schedule so nothing goes past due, and keep vendor records up to date.

- Handle recurring payments such as office rent and contractor/VA payments on their due dates.



Trust accounting and reconciliations

- Act as first reviewer on weekly bank and reservation escalations from our CPA firm. Track down what you can, such as a deposit that needs a reservation breakdown or a trust account charge that needs identifying, and keep each item moving until it is closed.

- Support trust (owner funds) reconciliation: work with our CPA, who pre-reconciles the trust account each week, to clear open items. Help clean up older uncleared items.

- Help match Xero bank and credit card feeds against transactions pushed from TopKey, and resolve discrepancies.

- Watch for chargebacks, unpaid owner payouts, and balance-due reservations, including OTA virtual-card payments, and resolve them.



Month-end close and owner statements

- Make sure all TopKey transactions are coded and all owner charges are pushed to Streamline by the 2nd of each month.

- Work the CPA's escalation list (issued on the 3rd business day) until reporting is clean, usually turning items around in 1–2 business days.

- Support the internal owner statement review: cancellations and clawbacks, reservations that cross months, late payments, new-unit commission splits, and owner charges. Statements are approved and owners are paid by the 10th.



Occupancy tax compliance

- Prepare and file transient occupancy/lodging tax returns for several California and Nevada counties and cities, on monthly and quarterly schedules, and send them for review before each due date.

- Help audit tax setups in Streamline (tax IDs, permits, and rates) and flag anything that needs fixing.



Process and documentation

- Keep our bookkeeping checklist and SOPs current. Write a step-by-step SOP or record a short Loom video for every recurring task you own.

- Recommend practical internal controls as we grow.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- 3+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience with US clients

- Solid grasp of accrual-based accounting, with real examples you can walk us through

- Experience with cloud accounting software. Xero is preferred; strong QuickBooks Online experience is fine, since Xero is easy to learn from QBO and has free training.

- Bank and credit card reconciliation experience, including what to do when the books don't reconcile and you can't find the difference

- Sales tax or lodging/occupancy tax experience: preparing and filing returns, and booking tax collected as a liability

- You understand the difference between owner-billable, company, and pass-through expenses

- You ask when something is unclear instead of guessing, and you catch and correct your own mistakes

- You follow up proactively. If a teammate isn't getting you information on time, you escalate clearly until the item is closed.

- Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software (our PMS is powerful but complex)

- Strong written English. Most of our communication is by
, Slack, and our accounting portal.

- Organized and consistent with documentation and SOPs

- Available to work the schedule above



THE TECH YOU WILL USE



- Xero (general ledger, bank and card feeds)

- TopKey (company cards, expense coding, receipts, bill pay and approvals, owner charges, Xero sync)

- Streamline (vacation rental property management system: reservations, trust accounting, owner statements, work orders)

- Breezeway (field operations and work orders that flow into TopKey)

- Our CPA firm's client portal (weekly tasks and escalations)

- Lynnbrook (owner payouts and chargeback monitoring)

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets)

- Slack

- Notion (documentation)

- Loom (SOP videos)

- Airbnb, Vrbo, and other booking channels (payouts and reservation details)



Streamline experience is a plus but not required.



NICE TO HAVE



- Vacation rental or short-term rental property management bookkeeping experience

- Trust accounting or 3-way reconciliation for client/owner funds

- Experience with TopKey or another expense/bill-pay platform that syncs to Xero or QBO

- Experience with another vacation rental PMS (Guesty, Hostaway, Track, Hospitable, etc.)

- Familiarity with how OTAs (Airbnb, Vrbo) collect and remit occupancy tax

- QuickBooks Online experience in addition to Xero

- A bookkeeping certification, or Xero/QBO certification

- Experience building SOPs and checklists from scratch



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A short cover note (1–2 paragraphs) about your experience with Xero or QBO and with sales/lodging tax

3. Your answers to the two questions below



Put the words TAHOE LEDGER in your subject line. Applications without this phrase or without answers to the questions will not be reviewed.



Screening questions

1. A $180 charge from a hardware store shows up on a company card with no receipt and no property listed. Walk us through exactly what you do next, step by step, until it is resolved.

2. You've reconciled a bank account and you're $312.40 off, and you can't find the difference. What do you check, and in what order?



Shortlisted applicants will have a video interview and a short practical test.



We're excited to meet someone who loves clean books as much as we do. Thank you for applying!

title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Scout for US Life Insurance Sales Team (Hourly + $150 Bonus Per Hire)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing, fully remote life insurance sales team in the United States. Our agency does around $2 million a month in production, and we are expanding aggressively. I am a manager on the team, and my goal is to build the biggest, hardest-working group of agents in the agency.



To do that, I need one thing more than anything else: a constant flow of motivated people who want to join my team. That is where you come in.



THE ROLE



This is a recruiting job. Your one and only job is to find people in the United States who want to become life insurance agents on my team, get them interested, qualify them, and book them on a call with me.



You will not be selling insurance. You will not be making phone calls. You will not be doing admin work. You will be hunting for talent and messaging people every day.



WHAT WE OFFER THE PEOPLE YOU RECRUIT



You need to understand this so you can explain it with confidence:



Fully remote. They can work from anywhere in the US.

Free leads. They never have to buy their own.

Free training, proven scripts, morning team meetings, and daily new agent training.

Direct access to mentors who personally produce $100,000+ per month.

Newer agents on our team with zero sales experience are averaging around $8,000 a month, and some are making $10,000 to $15,000.

A real leadership path. This is not just a sales job. Agents who prove they can produce consistently get the opportunity to build and lead their own team, which is where the biggest income in this industry is made.

They must get licensed. They take the state life insurance exam, and once they pass, they start selling right away. We guide them through the process.



Be honest with every person you talk to: this is 100% commission. Nothing is guaranteed. Our agents work 8 to 12 hours a day, every day. This is for people who are serious about changing their financial situation and are willing to outwork everyone around them. We would rather have 10 hungry people than 100 people who quit after a week.



WHO YOU ARE LOOKING FOR



Must be 18 or older

Must live in the United States (any state)

Hungry, competitive, coachable, and motivated by money

Willing to get licensed and work full-time hours on commission

Age, background, and experience do not matter. Hunger does. Great fits include people in sales, retail, restaurants, customer service, car sales, real estate, ex-athletes, recent graduates, and anyone who has said “I want more out of my life.”



THE RECRUITING PROCESS (YOUR WORKFLOW)



Find: Search for candidates on Indeed,
 (groups, job posts, comments, profiles), LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Craigslist, and any other platform that works.

Message: Send personalized outreach from your own accounts using our approved scripts.

Pre-screen: Make sure they are in the US and genuinely interested before sending the video.

Send the video: Send every interested person our overview video, which explains the entire opportunity: 

Follow up: Confirm they watched the video and are still interested. Most people need several follow-ups. Do not let anyone go cold.

Qualify: Once they have watched the video and said yes, ask our qualifying questions by message (hours per day, location and time zone, age, willingness to get licensed, and their goals). Copy their answers into the tracking sheet.

Book: Book everyone who passes qualification on a call with me using my calendar link. If someone is especially motivated, book them as soon as possible.

Track: Log EVERY person you message in our tracking sheet the same day, with their name, profile link, platform, and current status. No exceptions. If it is not in the sheet, it did not happen.

Report: Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers: messages sent, replies, videos sent, videos watched, candidates qualified, and calls booked.



IMPORTANT: Read this full post carefully. To apply, the very first line of your application must be the words LIFE INSURANCE in all capital letters, followed by your full name. Applications that do not follow this instruction will be deleted without being read.



HOW YOU GET PAID



Hourly pay: $4 USD per hour, part-time, about 20 to 30 hours per week

Performance bonus: $150 USD for every person you recruit who joins my team, gets licensed, stays for at least 2 months, and submits at least $8,000 in business in a month. This is paid on top of your hourly pay.

There is no limit on bonuses. The more quality people you bring in, the more you can earn.

The first 2 weeks are a paid trial. If you hit your weekly target of 10 booked calls, the role becomes long-term.

Top performers will be considered for raises and more hours.



We reward people who bring in recruits who STAY and PRODUCE, not just people who say yes. Find people who are genuinely hungry, not people who will disappear in two weeks.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



Part-time, about 20 to 30 hours per week, with at least some of your hours overlapping US daytime and evening hours (Pacific Time) when Americans are most likely to reply

Weekly target: a minimum of 10 new calls booked with me per week. Every booked call must be a qualified candidate who has watched the overview video and passed our qualifying questions. Missing this target consistently means the role is not a fit.

Excellent written English. Your messages must sound natural, friendly, and like a real American wrote them.

Self-motivated. Nobody will be standing over you. We look at results.

Organized. Every conversation you have must be logged in the tracking sheet with name, profile link, and status. Bonuses are only paid on recruits who are logged in the sheet.

Honest. Never promise anyone guaranteed income, never exaggerate what they will make, never lie about the job, and never spam people or break a platform’s rules. If your accounts get restricted, you cannot do the job.

Your own smartphone with active
, Instagram, and LinkedIn accounts, plus reliable internet and access to Google Sheets



REQUIREMENTS



Proven experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, lead generation, appointment setting, or social media outreach (required)

Experience finding people on
, Indeed, and LinkedIn (required)

Strong English writing skills (required)

Comfortable with Google Sheets

Experience recruiting for sales, insurance, real estate, or commission-based roles is a big plus and will move you to the top of the list



HOW TO APPLY



Follow the instruction from the middle of this post exactly. Then answer all of the following:



Describe your past recruiting, sourcing, or lead generation experience. What were you looking for, and what were your results (numbers)?

Write the exact first message you would send to a stranger on
 to see if they are interested in joining our team. Keep it short.

Someone replied “sounds interesting” three days ago but never watched the video you sent. Write the follow-up message you would send them.

Besides Indeed and
, name 3 places where you would find hungry people who want to make more money, and explain why.

title: Procreate Artist Wanted — Flexible Part-Time Work & Long-Term Collaboration
description:
We’re looking for a Procreate artist to create illustrations with our brush sets and record the drawing process.



We provide the visual concepts, references, and brushes, so you can focus on bringing the artwork to life. We’re looking for someone we can work with regularly and grow with over time.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• Flexible, fully remote work — choose your own hours and deliver in agreed batches.

• Around one hour a day on average to start — suitable alongside other projects or studies.

• Nearly finished visual concepts — no need to develop every idea from scratch.

• A paid test to see whether the work is a good fit for both sides.

• Long-term opportunities, with workload and compensation reviewed regularly.



THE CREATIVE WORK

For each assignment, we provide a nearly finished visual concept with the subject, composition, color palette, and overall direction already established, along with the Procreate brushes to use.



Your role is to recreate the reference with the agreed level of visual impact, texture, color, and finish. Thoughtful creative suggestions are welcome where they improve the result.



You’ll work with different Procreate brush sets, so illustration styles, techniques, and complexity will vary between assignments.



We’ll share sample concepts and links to artwork and drawing-process references with shortlisted applicants. These will help us agree on the visual quality, recording approach, workload, and pricing before starting.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re particularly interested in artists who can adapt to different illustration styles and make good use of expressive brushwork. Your portfolio matters more to us than a particular job title or number of years of experience.



You should be comfortable working with supplied brushes, following a clear visual direction, and keeping your Procreate files organized and editable. Additional brushes, imported assets, or significant modifications to our brushes should be agreed upon beforehand.



RECORDING THE DRAWING PROCESS

The recording is just as important as the finished illustration. We’ll use the footage in promotional content showcasing our brushes, so it needs to clearly capture how the artwork develops and how the tools are used.



We’ll agree on practical recording guidelines before you start, including canvas positioning, zooming and rotation, visibility of brush names, and keeping notifications and unrelated activity off-screen.



FOR EACH ILLUSTRATION, YOU’LL DELIVER

• A finished, high-resolution PNG.

• An editable .procreate file with organized layers.

• A full, real-time iPad screen recording, including all drawing sessions.

• The full-length Procreate timelapse.

• A short list of the brushes used, with their names clearly visible when selected in the recording.



OPTIONAL: FILMING THE DRAWING PROCESS

If you can also film selected artworks with a camera positioned above and slightly to the side of the iPad, showing both the screen and your hand drawing, that would be a big plus. We’re looking for clear, well-lit footage with stable framing and minimal glare.



Camera filming is optional and paid extra. We’ll agree on the requirements and additional fee beforehand. You’re welcome to apply even if you can only provide screen recordings.



WORKLOAD & PAY

Our starting target is approximately 30 illustrations with process recordings per month, with an initial budget of around US$300.



The illustrations will vary in complexity: a simple piece might take 15–20 minutes, while a more detailed one could take around two hours. We’ll agree on a balanced mix, aiming for an overall workload of roughly one hour per day on average, including recording, exports, and delivery.



The budget and volume are starting points, not fixed terms. Rates, complexity, deadlines, and workload will be discussed individually based on your skills, portfolio, working speed, and availability. More demanding pieces will be priced separately or accounted for in the batch price.



We’ll use the paid test to establish realistic expectations together. You can work whenever suits you — what matters is delivering the agreed work within the agreed deadlines.



CLEAR DIRECTION & FOCUSED FEEDBACK

We agree on the visual direction before drawing begins to keep creative guesswork and revisions to a minimum. Any necessary adaptations should be discussed in advance.



One round of minor revisions within the agreed brief is included. Significant changes to an approved concept or scope are discussed separately.



LONG-TERM COLLABORATION & GROWTH

We’re looking for a lasting creative partnership with someone who can become familiar with our brushes and visual approach.



As the project grows, we plan to offer more work, introduce more advanced assignments, and increase compensation accordingly. We’ll review rates and workload regularly by mutual agreement, with any increase in responsibilities discussed in advance.



INTERESTED? SEND US

• 3–5 Procreate artworks, ideally showing different styles.

• A drawing-process recording, if you have one — this would be a big plus.

• Your availability and a brief note about your relevant experience.

• Confirmation that you can work with our brushes and provide the required recordings and layered files.

• A sample of camera footage, if you’d like to offer that option.



We’ll discuss time estimates and pricing after sharing the references with you.



A short introduction and relevant work samples are enough — no lengthy cover letter needed. We’ll start with one paid test illustration and, if we’re a good fit, move on to a small batch and regular collaboration.
