title: Senior Property Accountant
description:
Senior Property Accountant: Commercial Real Estate (Yardi Breeze Premier)



Full-time · Remote · $15–20/hour + performance bonus · Unlimited time off

Open to candidates in the Philippines, Latin America and South Africa



Apta Investment Group is a physician-founded real estate private equity firm. We own medical office buildings and grocery-anchored retail centers across the Midwest for 85+ surgeon investors, with a 20-year track record and zero losses. “Apta” is Sanskrit for “trust.” Our investors trust us with their capital, and that trust rests on accurate numbers.



We’re hiring a Senior Property Accountant to own the accounting for our portfolio. You’ll work alongside our full-time Property Accountant, who handles day-to-day payables and receivables. You own everything above that: close, recovery setup, entity books, budgets, intercompany payables and the numbers our investors see.



What you’ll own



Month-end close: close each property within 5 business days. Reconcile banks, credit cards and balance sheets; book accruals; review payables and receivables before close.

CAM recoveries: prepare annual CAM, tax and insurance reconciliations by January 31, covering base years, expense stops, caps, gross-ups and exclusions, and set next year’s estimates.



Entity accounting: keep the books for each property LLC and investment vehicle: intercompany, capital accounts, distributions and debt.



Tax-basis accounting: track book-to-tax differences, and prepare the year-end package for our CPA so K-1s go out on time.

Budgeting and forecasting: build property budgets with operations, reforecast during the year, and explain variances.

Financial and investor reporting: prepare monthly property financials and the confirmed numbers behind quarterly investor reports.



New acquisitions and leases: set up new properties and leases in Yardi, and handle closing prorations and true-ups.



Required

6+ years of real estate accounting, at least 3 of them in commercial property: retail, medical office or office

Yardi Breeze Premier, or Yardi Voyager commercial and the ability to move into Breeze quickly

CAM reconciliations you have prepared yourself for NNN and modified gross leases

Entity accounting for LLC-per-property structures

Property budgets and reforecasts you have built

The ability to read a commercial lease and pull out every term that drives billing and recoveries

Excellent written and spoken English. You explain numbers clearly to non-accountants and flag issues before anyone asks.

Daily use of AI tools in your accounting work. AI prepares first drafts; you review and own the result.

Discipline to follow written Procedures exactly, and to improve them when you find a better way



Strong pluses



Medical office leases · investor reporting for syndications or funds · distribution waterfalls · CPA, CMA or a Yardi certification



How we work

Hours: full-time. Overlap at least 5 hours a day with U.S. Eastern Time between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, and join meetings as needed.

Tools: Yardi Breeze Premier, Ramp, Agora, Google Workspace, Slack and Notion

Procedures and AI: every recurring task has a written Procedure and AI support. We expect you to use both.



Our values: T.I.M.E.



Transparency · Integrity · Meticulousness · Evolve. Meticulousness matters most in this role: every number you produce reaches a surgeon investor.



Pay and benefits



Pay: $15–20/hour, based on experience and skills test results

Performance bonus and incentives: tied to an on-time close, accurate CAM reconciliations and investor reports with zero errors

Unlimited time off: planned with your manager, around month-end close and the January year-end and CAM season

Long-term role: direct access to leadership in a firm that is growing every year

Your resume

title: Multi-Channel E-commerce Manager - Amazon, TIktok
description:
Hypersonic Wholesale Ltd runs consumer brands across Amazon UK, TikTok Shop, Shopify, Temu and eBay, and is hiring a Multi-Channel E-commerce Manager to own the day-to-day running of every marketplace account. Immediate start.

You will be the single owner of account health, listings, compliance, cases and customer messages across all platforms, reporting directly to the founder. The core focus is Amazon and TikTok Shop, with Temu, Shopify and eBay alongside.



Key responsibilities

You own these across every platform unless stated otherwise.

Account health and compliance

• Monitor account health daily on every marketplace and act before metrics breach thresholds (Amazon AHR, ODR, late shipment; TikTok Shop response rate, LDR, violation points; eBay seller standards)

• Handle all policy notifications, violations, warnings and appeals, including drafting and submitting appeals with evidence

• Keep product compliance documentation current: ingredients, labelling, safety and certifications (particularly for pet treats and confectionery), plus any platform-specific compliance requirements such as GPSR, responsible person and category approvals

• Manage IP, brand registry and trademark matters on each platform

Case and dispute management

• Open, chase and resolve all seller support cases: listing errors, lost or damaged inventory, reimbursements, suppressed listings, account issues

• Keep a tracker of open cases with status and next action, and escalate to the founder only when a decision is needed

Listings and catalogue

• Create, upload and maintain product listings on every platform: titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ and brand content, images, variations, attributes and keywords

• Keep pricing, stock levels and promotions consistent across channels

• Set up new product launches end to end, including TikTok Shop product cards and affiliate samples

• Audit listings regularly for suppressed items, missing attributes and conversion issues, and fix them

Customer messages and reviews

• Answer all customer messages across every platform within platform SLAs (TikTok Shop and Amazon 24-hour response rate must stay above 90%)

• Manage returns, refunds, replacements and A-to-Z claims

• Monitor reviews and ratings, respond where appropriate and flag product or supplier issues

Inventory and fulfilment

• Create and manage FBA shipments, monitor inbound and stranded inventory, and flag reorder points

• Monitor TikTok Shop fulfilment and dispatch performance and coordinate with the warehouse team on any late orders

Advertising and promotions

• Day-to-day management of Amazon PPC and TikTok Shop ads campaigns: bids, budgets, negative keywords and reporting

• Set up deals, coupons, Prime Day and seasonal promotions across channels

Reporting and improvement

• Weekly report to the founder covering sales, account health, open cases, ad spend and what you changed

• Proactively bring ideas for improving sales, efficiency and account health, including how AI tools can automate or speed up the work

• Document SOPs for recurring tasks so processes do not live in one person's head

Must have

• 2+ years hands-on experience managing an Amazon Seller Central account (FBA), including listings, cases, account health and PPC

• 1+ years hands-on experience managing a TikTok Shop seller account, including Seller Center, Shop Chat, affiliate and campaign tools

• Completed relevant training in Amazon and TikTok Shop selling (please list courses or certifications in your application)

• Previous customer service experience, handling customer messages, complaints and returns to a deadline

• Working knowledge of Shopify, eBay and Temu seller tools, or the ability to pick them up fast

• Confident with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) for drafting listings, replies, appeals and SOPs, and able to suggest where AI can improve how we work

• Takes initiative: spots problems before being told, fixes what can be fixed, and comes to the founder with options rather than questions

• Highly organised with a tracker for everything, strong written English, and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

• Available to start immediately



Nice to have

• Graphic design ability (Canva, Photoshop or AI image tools) for listing images, A+ content and TikTok Shop assets

• Experience in pet, food or confectionery categories, or with regulated product compliance

• Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, IP complaints and trademark matters

• Experience with Amazon Ads or TikTok Ads beyond basic campaign management

• Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Notion or similar tools



Hours and availability

This is a full-time role: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day within UK business hours (approximately 9am to 5pm UK time), with a short daily inbox check in the morning so no customer message waits overnight.

Weekends: Marketplace SLAs run seven days a week. We ask for a brief check of customer messages and account notifications once on Saturday and once on Sunday (typically 15 to 30 minutes) to answer anything urgent. This is a light-touch commitment and will be reflected in the salary.



Communication: Daily end-of-day update in Slack or WhatsApp, weekly report and call with the founder.

How to apply



Send a CV and a short covering message

title: HMO Lettings Administrator / Manager
description:
Job Overview



We are seeking an experienced, highly organised and proactive HMO Administrator to manage the day-to-day operations of a residential property portfolio in Bristol.



The role involves overseeing the full tenancy lifecycle, from advertising available rooms and managing enquiries and viewings through to referencing, tenancy documentation, tenant onboarding, rent administration, in-tenancy management, maintenance coordination and end-of-tenancy procedures.



The successful candidate will have a sound understanding of UK residential lettings legislation, including the Renters’ Rights Act, HMO management requirements and landlord compliance obligations.



They must be confident communicating professionally with tenants, contractors and other stakeholders, maintaining accurate records and ensuring that all administrative and statutory deadlines are met.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of their responsibilities, manage competing priorities efficiently and work independently with minimal supervision, while recognising when matters require escalation.



This is a varied and responsible position suited to someone with previous residential lettings or property management experience who is committed to maintaining high professional standards and keeping their knowledge of relevant legislation up to date.



Key Responsibilities



HMO Lettings and Tenancy Management



* Advertising available rooms and managing prospective tenant enquiries.

* Arranging and conducting property viewings.

* Managing tenant applications, referencing and Right to Rent checks.

* Preparing tenancy agreements and associated documentation.

* Coordinating tenant onboarding, check-ins and check-outs, including inventories and photographic/video records.

* Administering tenancy deposits, prescribed information and end-of-tenancy deposit processes.

* Monitoring rent payments, managing arrears and maintaining accurate tenancy records.

* Handling routine tenant correspondence, enquiries and tenancy-related matters.

* Coordinating tenancy renewals, notices and end-of-tenancy procedures.

* Maintaining accurate records and monitoring relevant statutory and contractual deadlines.



HMO Compliance and Property Management



* Monitoring HMO licence conditions and relevant landlord compliance obligations.

* Maintaining records of statutory safety inspections, certificates and servicing requirements.

* Conducting routine property inspections and identifying maintenance, cleanliness and compliance issues.

* Coordinating maintenance requests, arranging contractor access and following up on completed works.

* Liaising professionally with tenants, contractors and other relevant parties.

* Escalating complex legal, compliance or property management matters where appropriate.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
LUXURY DAY SPA  |  WELLINGTON, NEW ZEALAND

Reservations Agent

Digital Advertising, Bookings & Spa Operations  |  Remote – Philippines

Position Reservations Agent (full-time)

Business Luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand (business name disclosed at interview stage)

Location Remote – based in the Philippines (work from home)

Reports to Managing Director (MD)

Hours 45 hours per week, aligned to the spa's trading days (Tuesday – Saturday) 

Shifts run approximately 7:00am – 3:00pm Philippine time (moving by one hour seasonally). Exact roster to be confirmed.

Base salary PHP 22,000 per month

Weekly bonus An additional PHP 800, paid weekly, for every week that treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more

Salary review After 6 months



About Us

We are a luxury day spa based in Wellington, New Zealand, offering a calm, contemporary escape with private treatment rooms, a steam room and a tranquil relaxation area. Our guests come to us to relax, rejuvenate and celebrate special occasions.

Our treatment menu includes luxury facials, relaxation and hot stone massages, body scrubs and wraps, hair therapy, foot rituals, pregnancy massage, and couples packages. We also offer midweek and seasonal specials, group bookings for birthdays and bridal showers, a membership program and gift vouchers.

About 95% of our clients are women, and they spend their time on TikTok, Instagram and
. Reaching them there, with beautiful and engaging content, is what fills our appointment book.



The Role

This is a hands-on, behind-the-scenes role that powers the whole business. You will create the advertising that makes the phone ring, turn those calls and
s into bookings in Zenoti, make sure our therapists deliver every treatment and are paid correctly, and then report on how the week performed so the next round of advertising is even better.

In short, you will be in charge of the full business cycle. It is a very interesting and rewarding role for a dedicated person who likes to see the direct result of their work, and when weekly treatment revenue reaches $8,000 or more, you share in that success with a weekly bonus.

The business cycle you will own



Why advertising comes first

Advertising is the engine of this role. Excellent, eye-catching content is what generates the calls and
s that become bookings. If the advertising is not done well, the calls and
s stop, and everything else in the cycle slows down. We are looking for someone who takes real ownership of this.

Key Responsibilities

1. Innovative AI advertising and content (the most important part of the role)

▪Zenoti marketing: run client campaigns and promotions through Zenoti's built-in marketing tools as the primary channel to our existing client base.

▪Paid social and search: plan, launch and manage ads across Meta 
 and Instagram, via Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager), TikTok, Google Ads and LinkedIn, within the budget agreed with the MD.

▪AI-powered creative: create innovative ads using AI tools for video, images, animation and copy, and connect AI video and animation platforms such as Higgsfield to produce scroll-stopping content.

▪Video library: build and keep a steady supply of attractive short-form videos (TikToks, Reels, Stories) showcasing our treatments, spa facilities, couples packages and current specials.

▪Know the audience: design every campaign for our core audience of women, with a strong focus on TikTok, Instagram and
.

▪Promote what sells: push midweek and seasonal specials, group and celebration bookings, gift vouchers and our membership program.

▪Measure and improve: track reach, enquiries, cost per booking and revenue from each campaign, and use those results to improve the next round of content.

2. Customer enquiries – phone and

▪Answer customer phone calls and
s promptly, warmly and professionally, in excellent English.

▪Advise customers on treatments, packages, pricing, availability, gift vouchers and spa policies, including the cancellation and rescheduling policy.

▪Turn enquiries into confirmed bookings and follow up on enquiries that have not yet booked.

3. Appointment setting in Zenoti

▪Create, reschedule and cancel appointments in Zenoti, matching each booking to available therapists and treatment rooms.

▪Fill the appointment book efficiently to make the most of therapist time and our treatment rooms.

▪Keep client records, notes and contact details accurate and up to date.

4. Staff coordination and treatment completion

▪Maintain close, daily communication with therapists and spa staff on WhatsApp about bookings, changes and customer queries.

▪Make sure every booked appointment goes ahead as planned and resolve any issues quickly.

▪Once a treatment is finished, confirm that payment has been taken and the appointment is correctly closed off in Zenoti.

5. Staff timesheet approval

▪Approve staff timesheets in line with the Sign-In and Sign-Off Procedure document, so staff are paid correctly and on time.

▪Identify and flag any missing sign-ins, sign-offs or discrepancies to the MD before approval.

6. Recruitment and training coordination

▪Advertise open positions for spa staff on job boards and manage incoming applications.

▪Schedule and coordinate training sessions with therapists.

7. Reporting and business performance

▪Run sales and treatment revenue reports in Zenoti and track weekly revenue against the $8,000 target.

▪Update the cash-up reporting every Saturday.

▪Update the weekly PowerPoint report and present it to the MD.

▪Share insights on what is working, and feed them back into the next advertising campaigns.

How Success Is Measured

▪Weekly treatment revenue, with a target of $8,000 or more

▪Number of calls and
s generated by advertising

▪Enquiry-to-booking conversion rate and speed of response to customers

▪Consistent, high-quality content and ads posted to an agreed schedule

▪Payment confirmed for every completed treatment

▪Accurate timesheets, cash-up reports and on-time Saturday reporting to the MD



About You

Must have

▪Excellent English speaking and writing skills. This is essential: you will be the voice of a luxury day spa on the phone and in writing.

▪Proven experience creating social media content and running paid ads on Meta, TikTok and/or Google Ads.

▪Hands-on experience with AI tools for video, image and copy creation, and a genuine passion for creative, innovative content.

▪Customer service experience by phone and
, ideally with New Zealand or other international customers.

▪Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage many tasks at once.

▪Confident with Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint, and comfortable presenting results.

▪A professional work-from-home setup, including:

–A stable, high-speed internet connection

–A calm, quiet working environment with no background noise

–A good-quality PC or laptop

–A good-quality headset with a clear microphone, so your voice is clear on every call

–An uninterrupted power supply (UPS) and a power backup for outages

Nice to have

▪Experience with Zenoti or another spa or salon booking system (such as Fresha, Mindbody or Timely).

▪Background in a spa, beauty, wellness or hospitality business.

▪Video editing skills (for example CapCut or Canva) and LinkedIn advertising experience.

▪Experience with recruitment advertising or staff scheduling.

Personal qualities

▪Dedicated, self-motivated and takes ownership of results

▪Creative, curious and quick to try new AI tools and ideas

▪Warm, professional and calm with customers and staff

▪Commercially minded: you care about bookings and revenue, not just likes

Why You Will Love This Role

▪You run the full business cycle, from the first ad to the final report, and see the direct impact of your work every week.

▪Creative freedom to experiment with the latest AI advertising and video tools.

▪A weekly bonus that rewards you when the spa does well.

▪Work closely with the MD of a luxury day spa in New Zealand.

How to Apply

Please apply through this job listing and include:

▪Your CV

▪A short cover letter in English explaining why you are right for this role

▪Links to ads, videos or social media content you have created (AI-generated work especially welcome)

▪A 1 – 2 minute voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

title: CRO Lead - Shopify Landing Pages & Funnel Optimization
description:
**Remote · Full-time · Independent Contractor · Flexible, output-based**



### About us



We are a fast-growing children’s supplements brand built around a simple purpose: helping parents support their children’s everyday wellbeing. We serve families primarily in the United States through our online store and care about the experience beyond the sale—from how we communicate with parents to how reliably their orders arrive.



We’re looking for a **CRO Manager** to establish and run a systematic conversion-rate-optimization program for paid-acquisition landing pages and the customer journey that follows. You’ll help us improve purchase conversion and revenue per visitor while protecting margin, customer understanding, and subscription quality.



### What You’ll Own



You’ll own the CRO process from research and prioritization through build, QA, launch, analysis, rollout, and documentation. You’ll work closely with Creative Strategists and coordinate with Meta campaign owners, development, customer experience, finance, operations, and lifecycle partners as needed.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Analyze Shopify performance, funnel behavior, customer feedback, support themes, session recordings, and other relevant evidence to identify conversion opportunities.

- Maintain a prioritized testing backlog with a clear problem, hypothesis, audience, primary metric, guardrails, and decision rule for each test.

- Independently build, edit, and optimize Shopify landing pages and straightforward funnel changes using the agreed tools; coordinate specialist development when custom implementation is needed.

- Align landing-page formats, positioning, messaging, proof, objection handling, and calls to action with paid Meta creative and customer intent.

- Own tests through implementation, QA, launch, monitoring, analysis, and supported-winner rollout.

- Validate assignment, conversion events, tracking, links, pricing, discounts, subscription behavior, and mobile/desktop functionality before launch.

- Classify results honestly as winning, losing, or inconclusive and maintain concise weekly updates on tests, learnings, priorities, blockers, and decisions.



### What Success Looks Like



During your first 90 days, you will:



- **Days 1–30:** Audit priority paid-traffic journeys, establish baseline CVR, revenue per visitor, AOV, and funnel metrics where data allows, document measurement gaps, deliver a prioritized roadmap, and launch the first experiment subject to access and implementation capacity.

- **Days 31–60:** Manage a repeatable experimentation cycle with a rolling backlog, documented hypotheses and QA, consistent reporting, clear blocker ownership, and supported-winner decisions.

- **Days 61–90:** Demonstrate credible commercial learning and progress through documented results, uncertainty, next decisions, and implementation of supported winners within agreed guardrails.



Ongoing success will be assessed through experiment quality and delivery, purchase conversion rate, revenue per visitor, funnel progression, AOV, and agreed margin, refund, subscription, and customer-experience guardrails. Fixed uplift targets will be set after baseline validation; test count or win rate alone will not define success.



### What You Bring



- Proven hands-on CRO experience with Shopify DTC or direct-response brands acquiring customers through Meta.

- Evidence that you personally owned the full testing cycle, not only advised or supervised an agency.

- Case studies explaining what you analyzed, what you implemented, how the test or comparison was designed, the primary metric, the result, uncertainty or limitations, and what happened next.

- Strong understanding of direct-response messaging, ad-to-landing-page consistency, mobile UX, customer psychology, objections, and purchase friction.

- Practical experimentation knowledge, including traffic allocation, sample-size considerations, stopping rules, and interpreting inconclusive results.

- Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics, GA4 or equivalent, Clarity or Hotjar, and an experimentation platform such as Intelligems, Shoplift, VWO, or equivalent.

- Ability to build or modify landing pages in the agreed stack, perform implementation QA, investigate tracking inconsistencies, and coordinate fixes.

- Clear written English, concise reporting, independent follow-through, and sound customer and commercial judgment.



**Useful, but not required:** Subscription DTC, supplements, skincare, or parent-focused product experience; testing bundles, pricing, subscription offers, post-purchase upsells, cohorts, or retention; direct-response copywriting and wireframing; HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Shopify Liquid; international-market experience; and sensible use of AI with output validation.



We’re interested in evidence of what you can do. Your application should show relevant CRO case studies, work samples, or examples and explain what you personally owned.



### How We Work

Most builds are "this API, that API, an LLM in the middle, put it live". We tell you the idea in plain words. You build it, put it live and keep it working.

- You have built real tools that pull data from an API and do something useful with an LLM (Claude, GPT or similar).

- You explain your work clearly in English.

- Full time: 40 hours a week or more, with at least 6 hours a day inside UK working hours (9am to 5pm UK time).



NICE TO HAVE

- A content, social media or agency background. We pay more for this.

- You want to grow into full apps: front ends, databases, deploys.

- You have used Metricool, Apify, Sandcastles or the Instagram or TikTok APIs.



PAY

$800 to $1,500 USD a month, full time. Your skill and your content background set where you sit in that range.



HOW WE HIRE

1. Fill in the short form at the link below. Record a Loom of up to 2 minutes. (The form also asks for a password. The password is apricot. It shows us you read the whole post.)

2. Our team watches every Loom. If yours fits, you get an
 to book a 15-minute call.

3. A paid trial task: £20, paid by us. It is a small version of the real work.

4. We pick one person.



THE LOOM (REQUIRED)

Show us/talk to us about one thing you've built that pulls data from an API and does something with an LLM. Show it working on screen. No more than 2 minutes. No video = no application.



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need someone to tell you each step.

- You cannot work at least 6 hours a day in UK working hours.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are a jewellery and accessories brand with a growing e-commerce and retail presence. We’re looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our product in stock and moving. You will own the flow of inventory from purchase order to warehouse shelf — placing POs with suppliers, managing inbound shipments, reconciling invoices, and building the reporting that tells the team what we have, what is coming, and where we are at risk of stocking out.



This is a hands-on role that sits between our suppliers, our warehouse partner, and our finance and e-commerce teams. You will work daily in Shopify, Looker, and Sage, and you will be the go-to person for accurate, up-to-date inventory information.



Work Structure & Requirements



🏠 Location: Remote / Virtual

📅 Schedule: Full-time

🌏 Time Zone: EST business hours

💵 Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Purchasing & Supplier Management



Place purchase orders with suppliers based on demand, current stock, and lead times

Track and manage inbound delivery dates, following up with suppliers to keep shipments on schedule

Flag delays or supply risks early and work with the team on solutions



2. Item Master & New Product Setup



Own and maintain the item master, keeping SKU data accurate and consistent across Shopify, Sage, and warehouse systems

Set up UPCs and all required product information for new launch products at the time of ordering

Ensure new items are fully set up before their first PO is placed and inbounded

Partner with product development to get SKUs approved in time for PO placement



3. Inbound & Warehouse Operations



Create and upload Advance Shipping Notices (ASNs) to our warehouse partner for every inbound shipment

Manage the receiving process end-to-end, from arrival through receipt confirmation

Resolve discrepancies between what was ordered, shipped, and received



4. Invoice Reconciliation



Review all supplier invoices and match them against purchase orders and receipts

Approve accurate invoices for payment and route exceptions to finance with clear context



5. Inventory Reporting & Analysis



Build and maintain reporting in Looker, Shopify, and Sage to give the team a clear view of inventory health

Analyse stockouts to understand root causes and recommend changes to prevent them

Maintain daily reporting on inbound shipments and inventory levels

Communicate inventory status, risks, and changes proactively to stakeholders across the business



6. Process Improvement & Automation



Drive efficiency by using AI tools to automate manual processes across purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and reporting



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in supply chain, inventory, purchasing, or operations — ideally in e-commerce or consumer products

Systems: ⚠️ Experience using ERP systems required; Shopify, Looker, and Sage (or similar e-commerce, BI, and accounting tools) strongly preferred

Purchasing: ⚠️ Hands-on experience placing POs and managing inbound shipments with suppliers and a 3PL or warehouse

Data: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, lookups, and recurring reports; comfortable reconciling data across systems and identifying discrepancies

Communication: Clear, proactive communication with suppliers, warehouse partners, and internal teams

Attention to Detail: Able to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously with high accuracy



Nice to Have



Experience with Airtable and SKU setup

Familiarity with ASNs, receiving workflows, and three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice)

Experience with demand forecasting or reorder-point planning

Experience working on an ERP implementation project

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, finance, or a related field



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Full-Time Amazon OA Product Sourcer
description:
FBA & FBM | Keepa & SellerAmp | Performance Incentives & Growth



Remote · 40 hours per week · Flexible schedule · Paid trial · Long-term opportunity



Build a Rewarding Role With Us



Please read the full posting before applying and follow the application instructions below.



We’re two US Amazon sellers working together to grow our Online Arbitrage businesses. We follow one shared set of sourcing standards; one seller fulfills through FBA and the other through FBM.



We’re looking for an experienced, dependable sourcer who can find profitable opportunities, research them thoroughly, and explain why they’re worth purchasing.



You’ll receive clear expectations, access to Keepa and SellerAmp, coordinated priorities, and regular feedback. In return, we expect focused effort, accurate analysis, consistent productivity, and dependable communication.



This is a serious, long-term opportunity for someone who takes ownership of their work and wants room to grow.



What You’ll Do



- Source profitable products from US retailers using manual sourcing, Keepa Product Finder, reverse sourcing, and storefront research.

- Analyze opportunities using Keepa and SellerAmp, calculating profitability for FBA or FBM as appropriate.

- Review price history, Buy Box behavior, sales demand, seasonality, Amazon’s presence, and competition trends.

- Verify exact product matches, including brand, model/UPC where available, size, color, quantity, and pack configuration. Flag packaging differences or uncertainty.

- Check selling eligibility for the assigned account using the process we provide, and flag restrictions or potential IP concerns.

- Submit complete, accurate leads in our shared Google Sheet, including product links, costs, profit, ROI, estimated sales, competition, and supporting notes.

- Identify whether each opportunity qualifies for FBA, FBM, or both. We will coordinate lead allocation and purchasing decisions.

- Provide daily written updates and participate in a weekly review meeting.



Our Sourcing Standards



- Minimum 30% ROI and $5+ net profit per unit after all applicable costs.

- Prioritize stable pricing, consistent demand, and replenishment potential.

- Prefer approximately 100+ estimated monthly sales. Opportunities with 50–99 may be considered with clear justification.

- Prefer fewer than 15 FBA sellers; flag 15+ for review. Evaluate competing FBM offers where relevant and explain whether demand supports the competition.

- Prefer listings where Amazon is not a seller. If Amazon is present, submit only opportunities with strong profitability, consistent demand, and favorable historical Buy Box data. Clearly flag Amazon’s presence and explain why the opportunity warrants consideration. All exceptions require approval.

- No clothing or shoes unless exceptionally profitable and sufficient to justify the return risk.

- No hazmat. Do not submit products the assigned seller cannot sell unless specifically requested for review.

- Avoid slow-moving, heavy, bulky, oversized, or fragile products unless specifically approved.

- Include verified gift-card discounts where instructed. Do not count cashback toward qualifying profitability.



Every lead must be thoroughly checked before submission. Do not rely solely on today’s selling price, a single sales estimate, or a profitability screenshot.



Calculate Costs Accurately



Our sourcing criteria are shared. Your calculations must reflect the fulfillment method:



- FBA: Include applicable Amazon fees, prep, inbound shipping and placement costs, and storage considerations.

- FBM: Include applicable Amazon fees, shipping to the customer, packaging, and accurate weight and dimensions.



For both methods, include applicable retailer shipping and sales tax. We will provide the cost assumptions needed for consistent calculations.



 What We’re Looking For



- Proven Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.

- Strong practical knowledge of Keepa charts, Keepa Product Finder, and SellerAmp.

- Ability to evaluate profitability for both FBA and FBM. Prior experience with both is preferred.

- Understanding of Buy Box behavior, sales velocity, competition, and realistic selling prices.

- Accurate Google Sheets work and strong attention to detail.

- Clear English communication, reliable internet, and dependable follow-through.

- Ability to work independently, explain your decisions, and apply feedback.



Attention to detail matters in this role. In your application, include “Favorite color: [your answer]” immediately after introducing yourself.



Our Expectations



Quality matters more than quantity—and consistent productivity matters too. We expect well-researched, purchase-ready leads that meet our standards, with concerns identified before we buy.



You should be proactive, communicate when you encounter challenges, and use feedback to improve. We will establish clear performance expectations during the paid trial.



Flexible Schedule, Clear Commitment



This is one full-time, 40-hour-per-week position supporting our shared sourcing operation. We will coordinate priorities and provide consistent direction.



Working hours are flexible. You should be available for brief check-ins or scheduled meetings between 9:00–10:00 a.m. US Eastern Time, as needed. Daily attendance during that window is not required.



Daily written updates and a weekly review meeting are expected.



Pay, Performance Incentives & Growth



- Starting pay: $4 USD per hour, with opportunities to progress to $5 per hour and beyond through consistent, strong performance.

- Tools provided: Keepa and SellerAmp access.

- Paid trial: Shortlisted applicants will complete a focused sourcing trial, with the scope, pay, and expectations agreed upon in advance.

- Performance incentives: Opportunities to earn bonuses based on lead quality and the sales and profitability generated. Written bonus terms will be provided before the trial.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with our businesses. Your starting rate is the beginning of an opportunity to earn more as you demonstrate your value and help our businesses grow.



Consistently strong performance may lead to pay increases, expanded responsibilities, and advancement into a senior sourcing or team lead role.



We value hard work, initiative, honesty, and results—and want your contribution to be recognized.



How to Apply



Introduce yourself and include:



1. Your experience: How long you’ve sourced for Amazon, the sourcing methods and tools you use, and your experience with FBA and FBM.

2. Two example leads: One suitable for FBA and one for FBM. Include the product, retailer, buy cost, selling price, estimated profit, ROI, and why it fits that fulfillment method. Previous or redacted examples are welcome.

3. Your judgment: Describe one lead you rejected and explain why.

4. Your availability: Your time zone, proposed working hours, availability for the Eastern Time check-in window, and earliest start date.



Finalists will complete a short paid trial and a brief walkthrough of their analysis.



Applications that do not follow the instructions in this posting will not be considered.



If you enjoy finding opportunities others miss, take pride in accurate work, and want a role where strong performance can lead to greater rewards, we’d like to hear from you.

This is NOT a marketing, content creation, or social media role. This is a technical, backend catalog and marketplace operations role.

2. Feed & Listing Health Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve marketplace listing errors in real-time (e.g., Amazon listing error codes 8572/5461, ASIN mapping mismatches, missing eBay Item Specifics, Walmart spec errors, and Google Merchant Center disapprovals).

Requirements:

- 2+ years of hands-on catalog operations across BOTH Australian and US marketplaces (Amazon Seller Central, eBay, Walmart Seller Center).

- Deep experience managing Shopify backends and multi-channel feed connector apps.

- Proven familiarity with Google Merchant Center feed diagnostics.

- High operational discipline: you thrive on spreadsheets, resolving technical errors, and strict daily reporting routines without needing constant supervision.

- Stable home internet (30+ Mbps down/up) with a backup power source (UPS/generator) and secondary mobile hotspot.

   - Point 1 (Platforms): Briefly walk through your hands-on experience managing Shopify alongside US & AU channels (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google). Which connector tools did you use to link them?

   - Point 2 (Error Troubleshooting): Describe a specific listing suppression or feed error you resolved on Amazon, Walmart, or Google. What caused the issue (e.g., GTIN mismatch, policy flag, attribute error), and how did you resolve it?

   - Point 3 (Daily Health Routine): Walk us through your morning audit routine. How would you inspect listing health across multiple platforms and report discrepancies on Australian time?

3. Profile Links: Include links to your OnlineJobs.ph and LinkedIn profiles.

title: Remote Controller / Senior Accountant (CPA) – QuickBooks Online, Cloudbeds
description:
ABOUT US

We are a growing US hospitality group based in Arizona with two businesses:

- A 10-room luxury boutique inn

- A multi-location head spa brand that is expanding into franchising



We are hiring ONE experienced accountant to own the books and month-end close for both businesses, reporting directly to our CFO. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who wants to own the finance function, not just do data entry.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run the monthly close for both businesses, completed by the 3rd of each month

- Bank and credit card reconciliations in QuickBooks Online

- Use Cloudbeds revenue and payment reports to record monthly hotel revenue, prepaid reservations (deferred revenue), and payouts in QuickBooks, and reconcile the two systems each month

- Reconcile spa sales, tips, gift cards, memberships, and card processor payouts from our spa booking system (Mangomint)

- Record payroll journal entries from payroll reports and review commission reports

- Produce monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash reports for the CFO

- Manage accounts payable entry, receipt collection, and vendor follow-up by

- Prepare sales tax and lodging tax figures for CFO review

- Keep books clean and organized for our outside tax CPA at year-end

- Set up and maintain books for new related entities as the company grows

- Document all monthly processes in a written playbook

- Light finance admin: tracking documents, following up with vendors and advisors, keeping files organized



MONTHLY REPORTING STANDARD

Our standard is "statement-verified" books, not just books that look balanced. Every month, for both businesses, you will:

- Reconcile every bank and credit card account to the actual statements, line by line, including any account not connected to QuickBooks

- Confirm all company cards and accounts are linked and nothing is missing

- Flag any difference between QuickBooks and the statements, explain it, and correct it

- Flag liabilities and risks before close (for example: taxes collected but not yet remitted, misclassified vendors, owner or related-party transactions)

- Deliver a short written close memo: what changed, what was corrected, and any open questions

- Provide the month's source reports from QuickBooks, Cloudbeds, Mangomint, and Gusto in a shared folder for executive reporting



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)

- Licensed Philippine CPA

- 3+ years running full month-end closes for US clients in QuickBooks Online

- Cloudbeds OR hotel/hospitality accounting experience

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting, deferred revenue, and reconciliations

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet and a dedicated, private workspace



STRONG PLUS

- Experience with Mangomint or another salon/spa booking system (Vagaro, Boulevard, Zenoti, Mindbody)

- Experience with multiple entities and intercompany transactions

- Experience with Gusto payroll reports

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Most work is flexible and can be done on your schedule

- 1–2 short video calls per week, scheduled during US Arizona morning hours (Philippine evening)



PAY

- $1,800 – $2,200 USD per month, based on experience

- Paid 2–4 week trial project before long-term hire

- Performance review and raise opportunity after 6 months



CONFIDENTIALITY

This role handles sensitive financial information. You will sign an NDA and work only in company-provided accounts with role-based access. You will never be asked to make payments or handle bank logins.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line: "CLOSE-READY CPA – [Your Name]"

Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, answer these 5 questions:

1. How many US clients have you run a full month-end close for in QuickBooks Online, and what industries were they in?

2. Describe your experience with Cloudbeds or hotel accounting. If none, describe the closest experience you have.

3. Our hotel takes 100% payment at booking. Each month, which Cloudbeds reports would you pull to record revenue and prepaid reservations in QuickBooks, and what journal entries would you make? If you haven't used Cloudbeds, explain how you've done this with another hotel system.

4. Have you used Mangomint or any salon/spa booking system? Which one?

5. Describe a time you found a significant error or missing account while reconciling a client's books. How did you find it, and what did you do?



Finalists will complete a paid skills test reconciling sample transactions in QuickBooks Online.

s or move appointments around. We are hiring someone to help run the operational side of a growing construction company.



WHAT WE OFFER

title: Remote Marketing Agency UGC Recruiter - Flexible Schedule
description:
We are a growing US-based digital marketing agency focused on helping brands build and expand their presence through organic TikTok marketing campaigns. Our team provides content materials and instructions, while our network of creators publishes slideshow videos on newly created TikTok accounts to promote different brands and products.



We are expanding our creator network in the Philippines and looking for motivated, dependable individuals to help us find potential creators, conduct outreach, and guide new recruits through the application and onboarding process.



We have a limited number of positions available and are looking for people who are serious about the opportunity. Consistent effort, accountability, and reliable communication are essential.



Responsibilities:



- Find Filipino creators interested in earning money by posting TikTok slideshow content.

- Identify potential creators through
 groups, Reddit communities, 
 servers, TikTok, university networks, and freelancer platforms.

- Reach out using our provided templates while keeping messages natural and personalized.

- Answer questions and guide interested creators through the application and onboarding process.

- Track daily outreach, including people contacted and application forms sent.

- Submit daily check-ins on recruitment progress, results, and challenges.

- Stay responsive to team messages and communicate proactively when you need help or encounter difficulties.



Important: Creators Don't Need Experience!



The people you recruit can be complete beginners! We welcome people who already create content, want to become creators, or simply want to try it out. They do not need an existing audience or previous content creation experience to apply.



Our agency provides content materials, guidance, and instructions to help creators get started. You do not need to focus only on established influencers—look for people who are interested and willing to participate.



What We're Looking For:



- Strong written English and professional communication skills.

- Confidence starting conversations and contacting people online.

- A self-motivated, organized, consistent, and coachable attitude.

- Willingness to follow instructions and work toward recruitment targets.

- Comfort with repetitive outreach and performance-based compensation.

- Ability to check in daily, track results, and respond to messages promptly.

- A valid PayPal account to receive payments.



Experience in recruitment, lead generation, sales, social media, community management, or customer support is helpful, but a willingness to learn and follow the process is also important.



Daily Communication Is Mandatory:



This position offers a flexible schedule, but consistent communication is required. You must complete daily outreach, submit check-ins, and remain responsive to team messages.



We understand you may have school, another job, or other commitments. You can choose when to work as long as you maintain daily activity and keep the team informed. Applicants who regularly go silent, fail to provide updates, or repeatedly ignore messages may lose their position.



Schedule and Compensation:



Schedule. Completely flexible. There are no fixed working hours, but daily outreach, progress reports, and communication are expected.



Base payment: $20 per 30-day cycle if you successfully onboard at least 35 creators, plus performance-based earnings.



Performance Earnings:



Your earnings are calculated using the following tiers:



- Creators 1–50: $1 per creator

- Creators 51–100: $2 per creator within this tier

- Creators 101+:$3 per creator within this tier



The rates apply progressively to each tier, not retroactively to all creators.



Minimum recruitment requirement: You must successfully onboard at least 35 creators during a 30-day cycle to qualify for the additional $20 base payment.



- Fewer than 35 creators: No base payment; you earn $1 per successfully onboarded creator.

- 35 or more creators: You qualify for the $20 base payment, plus your performance earnings calculated using the tiers above.



We encourage recruiters to aim for approximately 50 completed onboardings per cycle. Each cycle lasts 30 days, and progress resets at the start of a new cycle. Payments are made through PayPal at the end of each cycle.



Base-payment eligibility and continued participation depend on recruitment results, daily communication, and required progress reports.



Growth Opportunities:



We have a limited number of openings and want people who are genuinely committed to contributing to our agency's growth. Strong performers who consistently deliver results, communicate reliably, and demonstrate professionalism may have opportunities to advance into Recruitment Manager or Client Manager positions.



How to Apply:



Please answer these two questions in your application:



1. Where would you find potential creators?



Name three specific online groups, communities, or platforms where you would look for Filipino TikTok creators interested in earning money by posting content. Give actual examples rather than simply naming broad platforms such as
 or 
.



2. Why would you be a good fit for this role?



Explain why you believe you would succeed. Highlight any relevant experience and describe how you would organize leads, conduct daily outreach, track results, and maintain consistent communication with the team.



 Important Note: This Is a Flexible Side-Income Opportunity



This role is designed for people who want to earn additional income alongside their studies, current job, or other commitments. It is not a traditional full-time or hourly part-time position, and earnings are intended to supplement—not replace—your primary income.



You can choose your own working hours, but flexibility does not mean inactivity. Daily outreach, check-ins, timely responses, and consistent communication are required.



If you are motivated, dependable, and ready to contribute to a growing digital marketing agency, we encourage you to apply.

title: Full-Time Senior Construction Estimator – U.S. Commercial & Residential Projects
description:
About BP Construction



BP Construction Company is a growing construction company based in San Antonio, Texas, USA. We specialize in commercial and residential construction, including wood framing, metal stud framing, drywall, insulation, acoustical ceilings, and general contracting projects.



We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator who can independently manage the complete estimating and bidding process from start to finish.



BP Construction Company is seeking an experienced construction estimator who can independently prepare complete and accurate estimates for U.S. commercial construction projects.



We specialize in:



Commercial metal stud framing



Commercial wood framing



Drywall installation



Batt and sound insulation



Acoustical ceiling systems (ACT)



Exterior sheathing



Rough carpentry and blocking



This position requires direct experience estimating U.S. commercial drywall and framing projects.



We are not looking for someone who only performs basic square-footage takeoffs.



Responsibilities



Review architectural and structural drawings, specifications, and addenda.



Perform detailed material takeoffs using Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or equivalent software.



Prepare wall-by-wall framing and drywall takeoffs.



Calculate accurate material quantities, waste factors, and labor costs.



Request and compare material quotations from U.S. suppliers.



Prepare complete estimates, including labor, materials, equipment, overhead, and profit.



Identify scope gaps, specification conflicts, exclusions, and RFIs.



Maintain organized estimating worksheets and supporting documentation.



Prepare bid proposals for management approval.



Meet commercial bid deadlines with minimal supervision.



IMPORTANT: Required Takeoff Format



All framing and drywall takeoffs must include individual wall dimensions.



Metal Framing:



Wall type and location



Individual wall lengths



Wall heights and required stud lengths



Stud sizes, gauges, and spacing



Track quantities



Blocking, bracing, and other required components



Drywall:



Individual wall lengths and heights



Board type and thickness



Number of layers on each side



Board sizes and sheet quantities



Ceiling drywall where applicable



Providing only total SF or LF quantities is not acceptable. Detailed takeoffs must allow BP Construction to verify measurements and prepare accurate material orders.



Required Qualifications



At least 3 years of relevant construction estimating experience.



Previous experience estimating U.S. commercial metal framing and drywall projects.



Strong knowledge of U.S. construction drawings and specifications.

Excellent written English.

Advertising experience is beneficial but not essential. Experience in marketing, media or campaign coordination is also a plus.

Chinese, Hindi, Punjabi, Arabic or other community language skills are a bonus.

Full time, Monday to Friday, working Melbourne business hours (9:00am to 5:00pm Melbourne time). This is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time from October to April, and 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time from April to October, when Melbourne daylight saving ends.

Internet speed of at least 20 Mbps, plus a backup connection (for example a mobile data hotspot) in case of an outage.

PHP 35,000 to 50,000 per month, depending on experience.

Daytime Philippine hours, no night shift.

Varied work across campaigns, design, reporting and admin, with room to grow.

Performance-based pay reviews [and/or a per-settlement bonus, if you plan to offer one]

Your CV

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
About the Role

The Accounting Assistant manages Consilium Labs’ day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate

financial records, timely invoicing and collections, disciplined expense management, reliable reporting,

and effective financial controls. The role supports leadership with clear financial visibility while helping

protect profitability, cash flow, and operational discipline.



Duties & Responsibilities

1. Bank Management & Payments

● Manage and monitor company bank accounts, including daily balances, transactions, transfers,

and account activity.

● Review and process approved vendor, employee, tax, and other company payments in

accordance with established approval procedures.

● Schedule and coordinate payments to ensure obligations are paid accurately and on time.

● Maintain visibility into upcoming payment obligations and available cash balances to support

short-term cash-flow planning.

● Prepare payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals and supporting documentation are

obtained before payments are processed.

● Maintain payment records, bank confirmations, remittance information, and other supporting

documentation.

● Monitor recurring payments and upcoming obligations and escalate potential cash-flow concerns

or payment issues to leadership.

● Coordinate with banks and payment providers regarding account maintenance, transaction

issues, access, and required documentation.

● Investigate unusual or unauthorized transactions and promptly escalate material issues.



2. Billing & Accounts Receivable

● Prepare and issue accurate client invoices on time based on approved contracts, billing

schedules, and supporting information.

● Assist with billing setup for new contracts and maintain accurate billing information in relevant

systems.

● Monitor accounts-receivable aging reports and follow up professionally on overdue balances.

● Maintain accurate payment records, remittance tracking, and collection documentation.

● Maintain accurate accounts-receivable aging and promptly investigate billing or payment

discrepancies.

● Alert leadership to significant collection risks or overdue balances.



3. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

● Review vendor invoices, payment approvals, vendor files, and payment history for accuracy and

completeness.

● Process and schedule vendor payments only after required approvals have been obtained.

● Maintain accurate accounts-payable aging and visibility into upcoming vendor obligations.

● Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records and payment information.

● Ensure expenses are properly coded, documented, and recorded in the accounting system.

● Investigate discrepancies between invoices, payment records, and accounting records.



4. Accounting & Reconciliations

● Maintain accurate and complete accounting records and supporting documentation.

● Perform monthly bank, credit-card, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

● Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies in a timely manner.

● Maintain consistency and data integrity across accounting, invoicing, payment, and related

billing systems.

● Support a timely and accurate month-end close process.

● Ensure transactions are properly classified and recorded in accordance with company accounting

procedures.



5. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting

● Coordinate the financial processing of payroll with payroll providers based on employee and

payroll changes provided and approved by the appropriate parties.

● Maintain commission schedules, bonus tracking, reimbursement logs, and year-end payroll

documentation based on approved inputs from department owners and management.

● Ensure payroll-related accounting entries and supporting documentation are accurate and

complete.



6. Financial Reporting & Cash Flow

● Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, margins, collections, and

cash balances.

● Support budget-versus-actual reporting and investigate significant variances.

● Maintain visibility into expected cash inflows, upcoming payment obligations, and short-term

cash-flow requirements.

● Provide management with timely financial information and escalate material cash-flow,

overspending, margin, collection, or other financial risks.

● Identify unusual transactions or financial trends that require management attention.



7. Month-End, Tax & External Support

● Support the month-end close by ensuring required transactions, reconciliations, and supporting

schedules are completed accurately and on time.

● Maintain organized records for audits, tax filings, insurance requirements, regulatory requests,

and other financial documentation.

● Support external CPAs, tax preparers, auditors, and other financial advisors by providing

requested records and information.

● Assist with year-end accounting and tax-related documentation as required.



8. Finance Systems, Processes & Controls

● Maintain accurate and consistent information across accounting, invoicing, banking, payment,

and related financial systems.

● Assist with billing setup, vendor onboarding, and payment-system administration.

● Identify opportunities to improve finance workflows, controls, processes, and automation.

● Support implementation and maintenance of procedures designed to improve accuracy,

efficiency, and visibility.

● Promptly investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial systems and source

documentation.



9. Risk Management & Confidentiality

● Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, payroll, vendor, client, and other sensitive company

information.

● Ensure financial transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

● Alert leadership to collection risks, overspending, margin concerns, unusual transactions,

cash-flow concerns, or other financial risks.

● Follow company policies and internal controls related to financial transactions, payments,

approvals, and access to financial systems.



10. Finance Team Participation

● Participate in weekly finance check-ins and provide updates on outstanding accounting,

payment, collection, and cash-flow matters.

● Participate in quarterly performance reviews and annual compensation reviews.

● Collaborate with management and relevant department owners to ensure timely and accurate

financial processing and reporting.



Required Skills & Abilities

● Strong accounting, bookkeeping, invoicing, accounts-receivable, and accounts-payable skills.

● Ability to prepare accurate reconciliations and financial reports.

● Strong attention to detail, organization, accuracy, and financial discipline.

● Proficiency with Excel or spreadsheet tools and bookkeeping/accounting systems.

● Ability to manage multiple financial deadlines, records, and priorities.

● Professional written and verbal communication skills for client, vendor, banking, and advisor

interactions.

● Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information appropriately.

● Strong problem-solving, follow-up, process-improvement, and ownership mindset.

● Ability to recognize and escalate financial, collection, cash-flow, and margin risks.



Education & Experience

● Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Bookkeeping, or related background preferred.

● 3+ years of experience with bookkeeping systems, invoicing, payroll coordination, and financial

reconciliations preferred.

● Strong Excel or spreadsheet experience preferred.

● Experience in a professional-services or service-business environment preferred.



How To Apply

Send your application with the subject line Accounting Assistant – [Your Full Name] and include:

-Your updated CV

-A link to a 2-minute video introduction highlighting your accounting experience and qualities that set you apart from other candidates.



We value attention to detail and applicants who follow instructions carefully, so please make sure to include all the required materials. See you online!

title: WE ARE HIRING IMMEDIATELY — 2 POSITIONS AVAILABLE
description:

If you're a proven B2B salesperson looking for a long-term opportunity with a growing Australian company, we want to hear from you!

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

We are an established Australian cleaning and property services company operating throughout Sydney, Australia.

We provide professional cleaning services to residential customers, real estate agencies, builders, property developers and commercial businesses.

Our services include:

* Gym and fitness centre cleaning

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY

Your primary objective is to help our company generate new business by contacting potential customers across Sydney.

You will identify decision-makers, build relationships, uncover cleaning requirements and arrange qualified sales appointments.

We are particularly interested in generating:

* Ongoing commercial cleaning contracts

* Long-term relationships with builders and construction companies

* Real estate agency partnerships

* Recurring cleaning contracts with gyms, childcare centres, medical facilities and offices

We want appointments that lead to actual paying customers, not simply meetings booked to meet a target.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

* Conducting a minimum of 200 outbound call attempts daily

* Booking a target of 3 qualified appointments per day

* Cold calling Australian businesses

* Identifying potential cleaning requirements

* Presenting our services professionally and confidently

* Overcoming objections and handling rejection

* Following up interested prospects

* Re-engaging previously contacted leads

* Sending professional follow-up messages

* Scheduling sales appointments in our company calendar

* Maintaining accurate CRM records

* Recording call outcomes and customer information

* Providing daily activity and performance reports

* Working closely with management to convert qualified leads into customers

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

We are looking for serious sales professionals who can deliver consistent results.

Daily Targets:

* 200 outbound calls

* 3 qualified appointments booked

* Consistent prospect follow-up

* Accurate CRM updates

* Daily performance reporting

A qualified appointment must involve a relevant decision-maker with a genuine current or potential cleaning requirement and a confirmed discussion about our services.

We value quality, consistency and actual business generated.

SALARY & PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

Base Salary: $200 AUD Per Month

In addition to your base salary, you will receive performance-based bonuses.

Appointment Bonus:

* $3 AUD for every qualified appointment that is attended

Customer Conversion Bonuses:

* $5 AUD for each converted residential or end-of-lease customer

* $15 AUD for each converted builder or post-construction customer

* $25 AUD for each converted recurring commercial cleaning customer

Monthly Performance Bonuses:

* 60 qualified attended appointments: Additional $50 AUD

* 80 qualified attended appointments: Additional $100 AUD

Only the highest applicable monthly achievement bonus is paid. Appointment and conversion bonuses are separate.

Career Growth Opportunities:

High-performing individuals may be considered for:

* Increased base salary

* Additional sales commissions

* Senior sales positions

* Account management responsibilities

* Sales team leadership opportunities

* Greater earning potential as our company expands

We are interested in developing long-term working relationships with individuals who consistently contribute to business growth.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:

* Previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, confident and professional communication skills

* Experience speaking with Australian or international customers

* Strong objection-handling and sales skills

* Ability to perform high-volume outbound calling

* Proven ability to book qualified sales appointments

* Confidence speaking with business owners and decision-makers

* Strong follow-up and organisational skills

* Experience using CRM software

* Reliable laptop/computer, headset and internet connection

* Ability to work independently

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn

* Strong work ethic and accountability

HIGHLY DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE:

Previous experience in any of the following industries will be highly regarded:

* Commercial cleaning

* Facilities management

* Real estate

* Construction and building

* Property management

* B2B service sales

* Australian outbound sales campaigns

WE WANT TOP PERFORMERS

We are especially interested in applicants who can demonstrate:

* Consistent experience making 150–250 outbound calls daily

* A proven history of achieving appointment-setting targets

* Strong appointment-to-customer conversion results

* The ability to confidently handle difficult prospects

* Excellent rapport-building skills

* A genuine understanding of the B2B sales process

* Experience helping businesses acquire valuable customers

We are not looking for someone who simply reads a script.

We want confident, intelligent and persuasive salespeople who understand how to identify opportunities, create interest and move prospects towards becoming customers.

MANDATORY VIDEO RESUME — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

A VIDEO APPLICATION IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION.

Please submit a professional video introduction lasting approximately 2–4 minutes.

In your video, please explain:

1. Your name, location and previous sales experience.

2. What industries and companies you have previously worked with.

4. How many qualified appointments you typically generated.

Most importantly, sell yourself!

We want to see your personality, confidence, communication skills and ability to persuade.

Do not simply read your resume word for word.

Speak naturally, professionally and confidently, as though you were speaking to a potential business customer.

INTERVIEW & SELECTION PROCESS

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

We assess spoken English, confidence, sales experience and communication skills.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to discuss their experience, previous performance and sales techniques.

Read the advertisement carefully and follow the application instructions.

WHY JOIN US?

* Base salary plus performance incentives

* Opportunities for increased compensation

We are looking for ambitious professionals who want to build a long-term career, take ownership of their performance and help grow a successful business.
